title: Authority Ensign
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Quotes|quote=A bright-eyed recruit deployed to the Eastern Front. Three cheers for the cause!|author=Origin description}}
[[File:AuthorityEnsignIcon.png|center]] __TOC__ ::''Authority Ensign'' is an immersive faction-based [[Origin]] that works mostly in the [[Eastern Luminant]], performing authority missions to progress to higher ranks for exclusive rewards. ==Description== Authority Ensigns are, as the name implies, ensigns or soldiers of [[The Central Authority]]. It is unknown whether they are conscripted or volunteered, but as a soldier, they are subject to chain of command under the Authority. Authority Ensigns are affiliated with [[The Central Authority]]. ==Obtainment== To obtain the Authority Ensign Origin, the player must do one of the following: *Reach maximum reputation with [[The Central Authority]]. OR *Defeat [[Titus Fulminus Destellus]]. If your reputation is already maxed with the Central Authority and you do not have this Origin yet, commit a crime to lower your reputation and then do an event to raise it again. ==Spawn== Members of the Authority Ensign spawn at [[Port Merit]] with the [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]] and an [[Authority Helm]]. ==Effects== Your [[Guild]] will be automatically set to '''The Central Authority''' on that character, allying you with all members of the same Origin, which allows you use the shout feature (by starting your messages with !) to talk to all fellow Ensigns server wide. Your guild will reset back to normal if you wipe or get Exiled from the Authority. Your guild being changed is somewhat only a visual change; while you '''won't''' be able to use the [[Chime of Dwelling]], which is a major downside if you are already in a guild, if you claim a [[Guild Banners|Guild Banner]], it will still be under your Guild. You can also still interact with all of your Guild Base NPCs and respawn at your [[Guild Base]] if someone else places it down. After ranking up once, you gain the ability to jail players. If you manually grip a player, they will be imprisoned at [[Fort Merit]] and you will gain 80 points. This does not kill them (no life lost and no loot dropped), however, they'll be scheduled for execution in 5 minutes, drowning them and sending them to [[The Depths]] if they did not manage to escape. Visit the [[Escaping Jail]] page for a more detailed description. Most '''[[:Category:Authority Faction Item|Authority-related equipments and weapons]]''' can be equipped without meeting their normal requirements, without any penalty aside from (somewhat minor) effects such as damage scaling, which is a '''major''' benefit. Although you can automatically wear [[Outfits]] given to you from promotions, you '''cannot''' craft any non-Authority outfit to wear on your own, for [[Transmogrification|transmogging]] or otherwise, which is a '''major''' downside. All Ensigns will have an Authority insignia above their head to signify their rank, though your own insignia will be invisible to you. All of the previously mentioned neutral, beneficial, or detrimental effects or otherwise shall be removed upon being [[#Exile|Exiled]]. ===Salute=== Gain the Salute [[Emotes|Emote]]. File:Salute Emote.gif|Salute Emote ===Horn of Authority=== Gain a Talent Tool horn that marks escaping prisoners when blown by applying a combat tag onto them. The range of the horn is quite small, as you'll need to get fairly close to the prisoner in order for it to work. File:Horn.png ===Squads=== On the top left of your screen, next to the Help button, there will be an Authority Helmet icon with a red background, labeled "Squads." Clicking this will allow you to create a Squad with other Authority Ensign members. This is very similar to party systems in other games. Being in a Squad allows you to take on the Missions as a group and proc certain Authority Ensign Talents. This feature is highly recommended, especially at lower levels, as the enemies from Missions will often outnumber you and they do not have anti-gank AI. File:Squad Icon.png|Squads Icon File:Squad Invite.png|Invite UI File:Squadless.png|Squads UI (no Squad) File:Squad Member.png|Squads UI (member) ===Reputation Issues=== As you are affiliated with and work under [[The Central Authority]], certain factions will not take kindly to you. You also cannot raise your [[Reputation]] with The [[Kingdom of Etrea]] or [[The Children of Navae]], and your [[Hundred Legions]] reputation has a '''cap''' of high 'Ally'. *For The [[Kingdom of Etrea]]: You '''{{cl|lired|cannot}}''' raise your Reputation, and you start out as '''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}'''. **You cannot gain immunity to [[Voidwalker]]s due to Etrea being one of the many factions that gives out [[Bounty Hunting|Bounties]]. **You cannot complete the [[Duke Ishamon Erisia|Sin of Erisia]] questline, which means you cannot obtain [[Contractor]] or fight [[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] for his loot. **You cannot gain rewards tied to having good reputation with Etrea, which follows: ***You cannot obtain [[Stratos' Cloak]]. ***You cannot obtain [[Windwaker]]. ***You cannot obtain [[Fang and Coil]], unless you spawn with it from the [[Character Creation]] screen. *For [[The Children of Navae]]: You '''{{cl|lired|cannot}}''' raise your Reputation, and you start out as '''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}'''. **There is currently no effects or downsides gained from being hunted by them, not even [[Faction Ambushes]]. *For [[The Hundred Legions]]: Your reputation has a '''cap''' of high 'Ally', and '''{{cl|lired|cannot}}''' be raised further. **You are unable to get [[Legion Intelligence]] or [[Blightsurger]] on an Ensign character, unless you are a [[Khan]] or have the {{t|Celebrity}} Talent due to their requirements being higher than the high 'Ally' cap. File:Hundred legions cap.png|Reputation cap as an Ensign on every other Aspect Visit the [[#Reputation|Reputation]] section to see the starting reputation with other factions as an Ensign. All of the previously mentioned neutral, beneficial, or detrimental effects or otherwise shall be removed upon being [[#Exile|Exiled]]. ==Exile== Upon being exiled from [[The Central Authority]], you will be kicked out of the Central Authority guild, removing your ability to gain future promotions. You will return to your previous [[Guild]] and regain access to your [[Chime of Dwelling]]. All Origin-exclusive Talents, Equipments, Weapons, Mantras and Outfits you've obtained prior to being exiled will be '''{{cl|ligreen|kept}}''', although you can no longer exchange your Faction talents with the [[Shrine of Chance]]. You lose the ability to equip [[:Category:Authority Faction Item|Authority-related equipments and weapons]] without meeting its normal stat requirements, though any currently equipped items will remain usable until swapped out. In cases where it is swapped out, you cannot equip them again without meeting its normal stat requirements. Your Authority reputation will also be lowered heavily, most of the time to '''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}''' or '''{{cl|darkpurple|Villain}}''' reputation (though you can still raise your Authority reputation afterwards) and it will remove the restriction of not being able to raise your [[Reputation]] with [[Etrea]], [[The Children of Navae]], and [[The Hundred Legions]]. You will also lose a bit of reputation with [[The Divers]] and [[The Knives of Eylis]], and gain ample reputation with [[The Hundred Legions]] upon exile. Alongside losing your insignia and rank, [[#Salute|Salute]] now no longer appears as an emote you can use. You can no longer [[Jail]] other players. You still keep your [[Horn of Authority]], although it needs testing on whether or not it still works. There is '''{{cl|lired|no way}}''' to return to the Authority's ranks upon being exiled. There are two ways to be exiled: ===Deserter=== If you leave [[:Category:Territory of The Central Authority|Authority controlled territory]], a '''fifteen minute''' AWOL (absent without leave) countdown will be displayed at the top of your screen. If this countdown reaches 0, you will be marked as a Deserter, exiling you from the Central Authority. The AWOL timer will reset if you leave the game, restarting from 15 minutes once you rejoin. Additionally, the timer will not appear if you are on a mission, have joined a Division, are in a squad in which the leader is in the Command Division, are in a [[Dungeons|Dungeon]], or are in [[the Depths]]. File:AWOL.png|AWOL countdown ===Traitor=== Upon killing another Authority Ensign member of equal or higher rank, you will be marked as a traitor, exiling you from the Central Authority. This includes kills in other non-overworld locations. Non-direct kills, such as dropping someone in water or blowing someone up from cannon fire do not mark you as a Traitor. ==Progression== Speak to [[Captain Trist]], [[Captain Klave]], [[Captain Massi]] or [[Captain Rendez]] to gain a Mission. Missions are timed objectives that vary in difficulty depending on the objective. When taking a Mission, you and your squad will be teleported to [[Port Merit]]. Your current Mission objective and the Mission's location will be displayed on the top left of your screen, similar to [[Job Boards|jobs]]. You can right click the Mission popup to view its location on the map. The amount of time allocated to each mission depends on the mission location. Upon completing a Mission, you will have to report back to the Captain. This will also be timed. Upon reporting back, you will gain 45 points towards your promotion, EXP, a small chest, and 3-5 '''full''' training points. The amount of full training points depends on your rank. If you fail a Mission by running out of time, failing the objective, or dying (which includes resetting your character with Esc + R + Enter to teleport), you will lose 25 promotion points instead. The mission will also be considered failed if any of the previous things happen while you are on your way back to Captain Trist after a successful mission. Leaving the game will forfeit your Mission and may result in your promotion points being '''voided'''. It is not advised to leave the game during an active mission. Even if you aren't in a Squad, other players may be assigned to the same Mission as you. For some Missions, like Armanent Sabotage, if the Mission is completed, it will be completed for both parties. Dying during a mission only counts as a Mission fail for the person who died. Alternative to missions, you can also gain 80 points from [[Jail]]ing other players.

==Promotions== Through completing enough Missions, you will be promoted. Each promotion comes with benefits of their own benefits and rewards, being Faction Talent hands and potentially new dialogue with NPCs. Promotion points are '''reset''' upon being promoted. The message "'''YOU HAVE BEEN PROMOTED TO [RANK]. OORAH!'''" will appear when you reach enough points to rank up. You can change Faction Talents by using the [[Shrine of Chance]], but only if you are still currently an Ensign, and not [[#Exile|Exiled]]. Every Faction Talent available to you will appear upon every promotion, which means you will not be locked out of a talent due to a limit of talents appearing like a [[Whisper Draw|normal talent hand]]. You gain a Faction Talent hand upon every promotion, which means you get 1 talent from going from '''Private''' to '''Corporal''', and '''Corporal''' to '''Lance Corporal''', totalling to 2 talents. You do not gain a Faction Talent hand upon entering a division. In practice, this means that you are forced to pick 2 generic enlistment talents before you can start picking division-exclusive talents. How many division-exclusive (or more generic enlistment) talents you can pick depend on your chosen division. As you do not gain a talent hand upon entering a [[#Divisions|division]], how many ranks there are after your first division rank is how many talents you further get. The amount is 3 for the [[#Command Division|Command Division]], and 2 for both the [[#Inquisition Division|Inquisition Division]] and the [[#Shock Corps Division|Shock Corps Division]]. Keep mind that you can still exchange your Faction Talents by using the [[Shrine of Chance]] if you are not [[#Exile|Exiled]]. In total, from '''Private''' to the highest rank, choosing to enter the Command Division gets you 5 Faction Talents in total, and both the Inquisition and Shock Corps Division gets you 4 Faction Talents in total. ==Divisions== Upon reaching the Lance Corporal rank and meeting the additional requirements of a Division, you can join them, granting exclusive bonuses such as [[Weapons]], Unique [[Outfits]], [[Talents]], and new dialogue that changes depending on your rank and Division. Additionally, the AWOL timer will no longer appear, allowing you to go where you please, and most Authority NPCs, including both [[Category:Central Authority Enemies|Enemies affiliated with the Central Authority]] who aren't in active combat and regular NPCs found within Fort Merit, will salute you when you approach them. File:NPC Salute.gif At maximum Division rank, you will gain clearance to purchase to the lategame weapons in the Fort Merit Armory, such as the [[Sovereign's Punishment]] and various [[Pluripotent Alloy|{{cl|alloyed|Alloyed}}]] variants of Armory weapons. Each Division is unique in their themes, offering many avenues of gameplay and build diversity, but be warned as once you join a Division, you '''cannot''' go back or choose a different one.

Joining this Division provides the '''Glorious Charge''' Mantra, the [[Authority Captain Uniform]] Expert Armor, and the edges of your [[Adretian Aegis]] changes color from gold to grey. Additionally, upon reaching Seneschal rank, you can speak to [[Warden Jericho]] to receive the [[Rite of Authority]] weapon. Uniquely, this Division has 4 ranks, allowing you to gain up to 5 Faction Talents while the other Divisions are limited to 4. ===Obtainment and Ranks=== Complete 10 missions as Squad leader, then speak to [[Warden Jericho]] as a Lance Corporal. ==Shock Corps Division== The Shock Corps Division of the Central Authority sees frontliners taking the fight head on with overwhelming force.
Joining this Division provides the '''Grand Warden's Axe''' Mantra, the [[Shock Corps Light]] Unique Armor, and the color of your [[Adretian Aegis]] changes from blue to red. This requires a ratio of 3:1 for completed missions, meaning you will need to complete 3 missions successfully for every mission you fail. '''Ranks''' #'''Frontliner'''; This is the standard rank that is granted upon joining this Division. #'''Interceptor'''; The 2nd rank, granted after reaching 329 promotion points. #'''Operator'''; The final rank, granted after reaching 388 promotion points. File:Placeholder.png|Frontliner insignia File:Placeholder.png|Interceptor 1st Class insignia File:Ensign Operator Insignia.png|Operator insignia ===Exclusive Features=== *{{cl|factiontl|Absolute Force}} - Evolve the technique of your Oppressive Force, letting both hits of your flourish deal 50% more posture damage. **Because the second hit of Oppressive Force cannot receive posture damage modifiers, this Talent only benefits the initial hit of your Oppressive Force flourish. **Prerequisite: Oppressive Force *{{cl|factiontl|Amp Overdrive}} - Guardbreaking an opponent causes them to take extra thunder damage and applies Electrify for 7 seconds. **Deals 15 Thundercall damage. **The Electrify status effect changes your opponent's damage type to Thundercall and gives you 10% damage reduction to their attacks. *{{cl|factiontl|Martial Brutality}} - The less health your opponent has, the more posture damage you deal to them. **Increases your posture damage by 0.1% per 1% health missing, up to a maximum of +10% posture damage against someone at 0% health. *{{cl|factiontl|Shocking Reverb}} - Landing enough [[Thundercall|lightning]] mantras without getting hit grants you a defensive lightning cloak for 15 seconds, letting you negate damage from light attacks and [[ironsing]]. [2 min CD] **You need to reach a threshold of 150 scaled damage with [[Thundercall]] Mantras without getting hit to proc this Talent. **The damage buildup to reach the threshold is unaffected by resistances and damage modifiers. **Also negates damage from critical attacks and [[Silentheart]] abilities. {{MantraInfobox|newtable|end |name=Grand Warden's Axe (☆☆☆) |image=NoM1Axe.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Create a lightning axe! |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|ltn|Lightning}} |reqs=Shock Corps Division, given automatically after entering the division |effect=''The user summons a floating axe made of Thundercall and strikes their opponent.'' *If you M1 during this Mantra's windup, the axe performs a vertical radial slash, ragdolling and knocking back your opponent. This variant deals more posture damage. *Has a base damage of 27 with 2.75 Thundercall scaling. *The M1 variant has a base damage of 31 with 2.75 Thundercall scaling. *The base variant deals 10 posture damage. *Applies Shock on hit. WithM1Axe.gif|M1 Variant }}
==Pros and Cons== As a lot of pros and cons have already been previously mentioned under the [[#Effects|Effects]] section, it will not be reiterated again unless its importance demands it. As such, this will only cover an overview of this origin when viewed as a whole. ===Pros=== *Many Authority Ensign players have a high sense of comradery; if you're being ganked, especially if it's at or around Fort Merit, there's a high likelihood of at least one of your fellow Ensigns to come to your aid. Using the shout feature to call for help will increase the odds of you receiving assistance. **And as the punishment for killing fellow Ensigns is quite major, most other Ensigns will never attack you. *You can equip most [[:Category:Authority Faction Item|Authority-related equipments and weapons]] without needing to meet its full requirements. *Your player grip is replaced with imprisoning them. This increases the time before someone can spin back after a fight. *Origin-exclusive Talents, Mantras, Weapons, and Outfits. *You start with an [[Authority Helm]] and the [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]]. *Grants unique dialogue with a lot of Authority NPCs. Many of these dialogues will change based on your current rank and your [[reputation]] with the Authority. *The Master Armors from the Divisions are equipped instantly, completely ignoring their crafting materials and requirements. **But the Con is that because the Division Outfits are immediately equipped upon joining your Division without you ''learning'' the schematic, if you craft any other Outfit, the Division Outfit will be lost permanently. **Another Con is that you also cannot craft non-Authority [[Outfits]] while you are still an Authority Ensign; you can only craft other outfits if you have been [[#Exile|Exiled]]. ===Cons=== *Many of this Origin's benefits are locked behind a significant amount of time spent doing Missions. This will entirely take up your early-game progression on top of effectively softlocking you into only doing Missions until you join a Division. If you do not enjoy the gameplay loop of Missions, this Origin may not appeal to you as a whole, since it is a key part of the Origin and the Origin's progression. *Because your player grip is replaced with [[Jail|imprisoning]] them, you will need some kind of weapon or mantra that automatically [[Terminology (game)#Grip|grips]] in order to confirm kills. **This makes the obtainment of [[Tacet]], needed for the Tacet Minimization Talent in the Inquisition Division, a tad harder as you would need to rely on bleeding them out with light attacks if you don't have anything that auto-grips. Having outside help with allies that can grip normally also helps immensely. *As mentioned in the [[#Reputation Issues|Reputation Issues]] section, you cannot obtain stuff like [[Blightsurger]], [[Contractor]] and etc. due to the reputation limitations. **Due to the cap on [[Etrea]] reputation you will always be able to be voidwalked leading to unnecessary fighting and possible deaths. *Because your guild is "replaced" by The Central Authority guild, you will not be able to use the [[Chime of Dwelling]] or [[Guild Bases|Guild Officer]] tools. Being Exiled will remove this restriction. **If someone from your original guild places down the [[Guild Bases|Guild Base]] or spawns their [[Ships & Sailing|Ship]], you can reset and choose those as your spawn point. **You are still able to access all the [[:Category:NPCs located in the Guild Base|NPCs]] that are located in the guild base. *There is no option to toggle or limit the shout feature, so your messages to your friends in the server will be intercepted by other Ensigns, and you may be subject to seeing shout messages that breaks Roblox's ToS or are otherwise not family friendly. **Remember to report messages like these. *If you aren't on a Mission, haven't joined a Division, or aren't in the squad of a player in the Commander Division, you are only given 15 minutes to return to Authority controlled territory before being Exiled. *Most Cons (and some Pros) are removed once the player has been [[#Exile|Exiled]], but exile has its own benefits and drawbacks. Visit the [[#Exile|Exile]] section for more information. ==Reputation== Your starting faction [[reputation]] is: *'''{{cl|medgreen|Ally}}''' with [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} *'''{{cl|ligreen|Friend}}''' of [[The Divers]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}}, [[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}}, and [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}} *'''{{cl|lipurple|Enemy}}''' of [[The Ministry]] {{FactionIcon|Ministry}} and [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}} *'''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}''' by [[Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}} and [[The Children of Navae]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}} *'''{{cl|liorange|Neutral}}''' with all other factions {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}} {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}} {{FactionIcon|Hive}} {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}} *''Note: Your chosen [[Aspect]] may affect your starting reputation.'' *You '''{{cl|lired|cannot gain}}''' [[Etrea]] or [[Children of Navae]] reputation. This restriction will be removed, should you be [[#Exile|Exiled]]. **This restriction will be removed, should you be [[#Exile|Exiled]]. Visit the [[#Reputation Issues|Reputation Issues]] section for major effects caused by this. *Your [[Hundred Legions]] reputation has a '''cap''' of high 'Ally', and '''{{cl|lired|cannot}}''' be raised further. **This restriction will be removed, should you be [[#Exile|Exiled]]. Visit the [[#Reputation Issues|Reputation Issues]] section for major effects caused by this. If you have the [[Fugitive]] Flaw: *'''{{cl|ligreen|Friend}}''' of [[The Central Authority]] {{FactionIcon|Central Authority}} *'''{{cl|lipurple|Enemy}}''' of [[The Divers]] {{FactionIcon|Divers}}, [[Lost Celtor]] {{FactionIcon|Lost Celtor}}, [[The Ignition Union]] {{FactionIcon|Ignition Union}}, [[The Hive]] {{FactionIcon|Hive}}, [[The Summer Company]] {{FactionIcon|The Summer Company}}, and [[The Knives of Eylis]] {{FactionIcon|Knives of Eylis}} *'''{{cl|medpurple|Hunted}}''' by [[Etrea]] {{FactionIcon|Etrea}}, [[The Children of Navae]] {{FactionIcon|Children of Navae}}, [[The Hundred Legions]] {{FactionIcon|Hundred Legions}}, and [[The Ministry]] {{FactionIcon|Ministry}} *'''Neutral''' with all other factions {{FactionIcon|Etrean Royalists}} ==Trivia== *The usage of ranks is incorrect, as a Lance Corporal is actually ranked below a Corporal. *Despite the [[Summer Company]] being on similarly friendly terms with the Central Authority, only the Divers and Ignition Union have Friend reputation with newly spawned Authority Ensigns. This is extra ironic as the Ignition Union have openly expressed disdain for the Authority and that they need to be stopped. This is likely due to past Authority treachery{{Ref/WeaponDescription|Rifle Spear}} and the Authority's refusal to pick a side in the Ignition-Summer conflict causing the Company to view them less favorably, even if they are willing to accept their finances. *Funnily enough, the Shock Corps Division has the most issues regarding its acquirement, as its requirements are unclear to this day. *The Buster Call Talent is a direct reference to ''One Piece'', being a tactic employed by the Marines where 10 warships are called to bombard a location. ==References== {{History}} {{Nav|Origins}} [[Category:The Central Authority]] [[Category:Character]] [[Category:Origins]] [[Category:Faction Origins]]

title: Authority Lieutenant
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |health=1000 |weapon=*[[Cavalry Saber]] *[[Adretian Axe]] *[[Mace]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Fire Blade *Strong Left |drops=*[[Frigid Prism]]|image1=AuthorityLieutenant.png|caption1=That's a lovely DONATION for His Majesty's Bri'ish Museum ya got there}} ==Description== The Authority Lieutenant is an NPC found outside the shipwright hut in [[Fort Merit]], via [[Faction Ambushes]], or fighting with [[Legion Captain]]s in [[Starswept Valley]]. Their appearance consists of a Authority Captain Uniform, the [[Bluesteel Boots]] and [[Bluesteel Pauldrons|Pauldrons]], a black [[Shrouded Cape]] and, unusually for an Authority member, [[Aristocrat Eyeglasses]], however for some odd reason they wear their [[Authority Helm|helmet]] too. They are similar in appearance to the [[Authority Captain]] and [[Authority Commander (NPC)|Authority Commander]]. ==Moveset== Their arsenal is composed of an Cavalry Saber/Adretian Axe/Mace along with the [[Flamecharm]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Desciption |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |([[Cavalry Saber]]): Performs four quick slashes with their blade. ([[Adretian Axe]]): Does a windup by rising the weapon before slamming its blade on you.
([[Mace]]): Raises club upward before slamming it down to the ground. *Adretian Axe and Mace criticals are not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★★☆) |User slams down with their blade coated in flames. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Flame Grab'''
(★★☆) |User lunges forward for a grab that slams and burns incoming opponents into the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Ash Slam'''
(★★★) |User imbues their fist with flames that explode on impact with the ground. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |} ===Talents=== *Azure Flames - Many of their flames turn blue, signifying their increased intensity. *{{cl|raretlnf|Mirage Clone}} - Dodging attacks will leave behind a heat mirage clone that sets their enemy on fire. *Agitating Spark - Flame attacks spread to anybody nearby, including themselves. *{{cl|raretlnf|The Final Act}} - Flame mantras landed after a flourish will explode their opponent. *Immolation - Hitting their opponent while on fire will apply fire damage, while also taking 50% less damage from self inflicted flames. *{{cl|advancedtlnf|Phoenix Flames}} - Any time an Authority Lieutenant would burn to death, they instead revive with half of their health restored. *Corpse Explosion - Bodies they burn to death instantly detonate, dealing damage to anybody nearby. Their flames will also incinerate knocked targets much faster. *Controlled Combustion - Their Agitating Spark no longer spreads to those allied with them. ==Finisher== An Authority Lieutenant executes its opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |([[Cavalry Saber]]):Pins down opponent before slicing their throat. ([[Adretian Axe]]):Pins down the opponent before splitting their skull with the weapon. ([[Mace]]):Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face with mace. |} ==Gallery== AuthorityLieutenantNew.png|Old appearance ==Trivia== *The Authority Lieutenant's dialogue when they are being executed is usually "You're pretty strong...", "How is this even possible?" or "What is someone of your strength doing here...?" the same as the Authority Captain. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]] [[Category:Ambush Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]]

title: Authority Officer
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |health=400 |weapon=*[[Officer Saber]] *[[Mace]] *[[Adretian Axe]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Jolt Grab *Thunder Kick |drops=*[[Authority Helm]] *[[Spark Gland]] |image1=authorityfootsoldier.png |caption1=Jolt Grab go brrr}} ==Description== Authority officers are a type of enemy NPC working for [[The Central Authority]] that are frequently found around [[Erisia]]. They can spawn in the following events: *Authority Officers vs [[Vigil Swordsman|Vigil Swordsmen]] ([[Erisia]]) *Authority Officers vs [[Etrean Soldier|Etrean Soldiers]] ([[Upper Erisia]]) *Authority Officers vs [[Legion Soldier|Legion Soldiers]] ([[Upper Erisia]]) * Authority Officers with [[Authority Soldier|Authority Soldiers]] patrolling ([[Upper Erisia]]) **Defeating all four of them will reward the player with a chest containing low level gear along with negative reputation with The Central Authority. They are also the higher ranked and more dangerous counterpart to the [[Authority Soldier]]. Authority officers wear an [[Authority Helm]], a pair of [[Bluesteel Pauldrons]], a pair of [[Bluesteel Boots]] and an [[Authority Captain Uniform]]. ==Moveset== Their arsenal consists of a [[Cavalry Saber]], [[Adretian Axe]] or a [[Mace]] (all of which can be enchanted) and the [[Thundercall]] Attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Cavalry Saber]]] Performs a wind-up before thrusting sword forward. [[[Mace]]] Raises club upward before slamming it down to the ground.
[[[Adretian Axe]]] Does a windup by rising the weapon before slamming its blade on you. *Mace and Adretian Axe criticals are not blockable. *Adretian Axe critical grants hyperarmor during its windup. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Jolt Grab'''
(★★☆) |Grabs the nearest target with an electrified grasp. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |- |
'''Thunder Kick'''
(★★☆) |User performs an empowered lightning kick, shocking and knocking away any opponents. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Lightning Blade'''
(★☆☆) |Arcing blades of electricity. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} === Talents === * First Interrogation - Attacks from opponents who are Electrified will give you ether proportional to their initial damage. * Second Interrogation - Electrified attacks do 50% less damage and posture damage to you. * Authority Intimidation - All moves that apply electricity slow the opponent more. * Resolve Crusher - Lightning moves now have a chance to apply "Electrify", attacks from electrified opponents are converted into lightning damage, but will deal 10% less damage to you. * Surge Path: Unstable Capacitor - Your lightning no longer applies Shock, instead apply Surge. At maximum stacks of Surge, your opponents will Overload, sending arcs of lightning in every direction. * {{cl|raretlnf|Showstopper}} - When an enemy would roll through one of your physical attacks, stomp the ground, dazing anyone nearby. Removes speed buffs from target upon landing. ==Finisher== An Authority Officer executes its opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |[[[Cavalry Saber]]] Pins down opponent before slicing their throat with blade. [[[Mace]]] Pins down opponent before firmly bashing their face with mace.
[[[Adretian Axe]]] Pins down the opponent before splitting their skull with the weapon. |} ==Tips== *Run if you're inexperienced as its [[Thundercall]] mantras deal a lot of damage. ==Trivia== *An Authority officer can lose to a [[Mudskipper]] if it gets backed into a corner. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]]

If you were looking for a different page, view the [[Authority Guard (disambiguation)|disambiguation]].'' {{EnemyInfobox |health=1200 |weapon=*[[Rifle Spear]] *[[Officer Saber]] *[[Adretian Axe]] |moves=*Assault *Critical *Fire Blade *Relentless Flames *Flame Grab |drops=*[[Authority Helm]] |image1=Authority Guard.png |caption1=Turns out the many, the few, the big, the small only applied to Blue people |affiliation=[[The Central Authority]]}} ==Description== ''Not to be confused with the outfit of a similar name, the [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]]'' Authority Peacekeepers are a type of enemy NPC found patrolling [[Fort Merit]]. Despite their intimidating appearance, they are surprisingly weak compared to the [[Authority Officer]]. Their appearance consists of a Authority Peacekeeper Uniform and an Authority Helmet. They are almost identical to the [[Authority Soldier]], with only those wielding the [[Rifle Spear]] being unique at a glance. ==Moveset== Their arsenal is composed of a [[Rifle Spear]], [[Cavalry Saber]] or [[Adretian Axe]] along with the [[Flamecharm]] attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Desciption |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |([[Rifle Spear]])Pulls the trigger on the spear that fires a bullet at opponent. ([[Cavalry Saber]])Performs four quick slashes with their blade.
([[Adretian Axe]])Does a windup by rising the weapon before slamming it's blade on you. *Adretian Axe critical is not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★★☆) |Slams down with a blade coated in flame, dealing heavy damage in an arc. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Relentless Flames'''
(★★☆) |Bear down on your foes with repeated fiery slashes. *Cancels if parried. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Flame Grab'''
(★☆☆) |The Peacekeeper lunges forward to grab and slam the player into the ground, igniting them in flames. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |} === Talents === * {{t|All-Consuming Flame}} - Your flames will incinerate unconscious Targets much faster. * {{t|Corpse Explosion}} - Bodies that you burn to death immediately explode dealing massive damage. * {{t|Flaming Flourish}} - Set enemies on fire when you flourish or uppercut them. * {{t|Hell's Partisan}} - After landing a flame dagger on an opponent, your next hit against them will impale with a divine spear from above. * {{cl|raretlnf|Speed Demon}} - Your attacks now inflict bleed while you have a speed boost. * {{cl|raretlnf|The Final Act}} - Landing a fire mantra immediately after flourishing an opponent will cause them to explode. == Finisher == An Authority Peacekeeper executes it's opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |([[Cavalry Saber]]):Pins down opponent before slicing their throat. ([[Adretian Axe]]):Pins down the opponent before splitting their skull with the weapon. ([[Rifle Spear]]):Pins down the opponent before impaling them through the chest with the spear. |} == Trivia == *Despite their dialogue referring to them as 'Authority Guard,' dying to one reveals they are called 'Authority Peacekeeper.' {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]]

The armour is specially forged by techniques developed in the [[Central Luminant]], creating an uncharacteristically versatile armour plate. }}'''Authority Peacekeeper Armour''' is an Adept [[Outfit]] in ''Deepwoken''. == Statistics == ===''Requirements''=== This Outfit costs {{c|Notes|30}} and requires five (5) [[Cloth]], five (5) [[Fiber]], and one (1) [[Iron]] to craft. This Outfit additionally requires the player to be at least [[Power]] 5 and have at least 5 [[Fortitude]] to be crafted. This Outfit '''cannot''' be crafted unless you are an [[Authority Ensign]]. Alternatively, using the [[Authority Ensign]] Origin will grant it for free, ignoring all requirements. ===''Armor Stats''=== This Outfit has 1600 durability, grants {{stats|phys|+15% Physical resistance}}, {{stats|slash|+10% Slash resistance}}, {{stats|elm|+10% Elemental resistance}}, and {{stats|flm|+15% Fire resistance}}. Additionally, it provides the {{t|Lowstride}} Talent. *Due to resistances being combined multiplicatively instead of additively, the total resistances are: {{stats|slash|23.5% Slash}}, {{stats|blunt|15% Blunt}}, {{stats|flm|23.5% Flamecharm}}, and {{stats|elm|10% Elemental|flm=n}}. The {{t|Lowstride}} Talent increases your [[Stealth]] and movement speed while crouching. Additionally, this removes the sound that sheathing and unsheathing your weapon makes. ==Gallery== Authorityarmour.png|Concept art ==Trivia== *This is the standard uniform of The Authority. **Notably, the [[Authority Captain Uniform]] is just this but with a red coat over it. *One of the best Adept armors in game because of the low cost, excellent durability, and the material requirements. {{History}} {{Nav|Outfits}} [[Category:Outfits]] [[Category:Outfits of The Central Authority]] [[Category:Outfits with Talents]] [[Category:Outfits with Non-exclusive Talents]]

Authority Sniper wear [[Citadel Frames]] with pair of [[Bluesteel Pauldrons]], a pair of [[Bluesteel Boots]] and a [[Shock Corps Light]] [[Outfit]]. ==Moveset== Their arsenal consists of a [[Rifle Spear]] (can be enchanted) and the [[Thundercall]] Attunement: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''

title: Authority Soldier
content:
{{EnemyInfobox |image1=RegularAuthorityFootsoldier.png |moves=*Assault *Critical *Flame Grab *Fire Blade *Burning Servants |health=200 |weapon=*[[Adretian Axe]] *[[Officer Saber]] |drops=*[[Authority Helm]] *[[Dying Embers]] |affiliation=[[The Central Authority]]}} ==Description== Authority Soldiers are enemy NPCs found in [[Upper Erisia]] and on [[Meteor Isle]]. They are ranked the lowest, and thus the most incompetent members of The Central Authority's army, frequently accidently incinerating or setting each other on fire. As a result, they have a standard appearance, sporting an [[Authority Peacekeeper Armor]] and an [[Authority Helm]]. They can spawn in the following events: * 2 '''Authority Soldiers''' with 2 [[Authority Officer]]s patrolling [[Upper Erisia]]. * 2 '''Authority Soldiers''' raiding [[Meteor Isle]]. == Moveset == An Authority Soldier's arsenal consists of either a [[Adretian Axe]] or an [[Officer Saber]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Officer Saber]]] Performs four quick slashes with their blade. [[[Adretian Axe]]] Raises axe before firmly slamming it down to the ground. *Adretian Axe critical is not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Fire Blade'''
(★★☆) |Slams down with a blade coated in flame, dealing heavy damage in an arc. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Burning Servants'''
(★☆☆) |Summon a legion of flaming spearmen that lunge inwards. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Flame Grab'''
(★☆☆) |The Soldier lunges forward to grab and slam the player into the ground, igniting them in flames. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, knockdown }} |} ===Talents=== *Hell's Partisan - After landing a flame dagger on an opponent, your next hit against them will impale with a divine spear from above. *Warding Radiance - Every fire mantra builds up one halo stack. At 3 stacks a halo appears that allows you to slide further. Hell's Partisan is also triggered passively while this is active. *Flaming Flourish - Set enemies on fire when you flourish or uppercut them. *To The Finish - You take 10% less damage when below 30% health. *Immolation - Fire spells cost 70% less while on fire. If you hit someone while on fire, apply fire damage. You take 50% less damage from self-inflicted flames. ==Gallery== AuthSoldierMunchies.png|An Authority Soldier being eaten by a [[Megalodaunt]] ==Trivia== *They are one of two Authority enemies that can be non-Adrets, the other being the [[Authority Peacekeeper]]. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Central Authority Enemies]]

title: Bamboo Bundle

== Description ==
'''Bamboo Bundle''' is an [[Ingredients|Ingredient]] in Deepwoken. It can be used to craft [[Fiber]], and can commonly be found near the shores of [[Erisia]], [[Etris]], [[Miner's Landing]], and [[Songseeker Wilds]], and on grass in Etris and [[Isle of Vigils]]. It is found in bunches of tall, green bamboo stems which can be harvested by the player.  

Every two Bamboo is equal to one Fiber, which every three of is equal to one [[Cloth]]. So, six bamboo is equal to one Cloth.

== Gallery ==
<gallery widths="400" position="center">
Bamboo.png|Bamboo found in the spring
</Gallery>

== Trivia ==
* In the June 9th, 2025 update, Bamboo that would occur on shores was replaced with [[Marram Grass]].
* The Bamboo Bundle changes color depending on the [[Seasons|season]], being a lighter green in the Spring and a darker green in the Summer.

They spawn in groups of 3 in [[Erisia]], spawn in a pair in [[Etris]] and [[Isle of Vigils]] and can spawn in groups of 3-7 on [[Summer Isle]] as part of an event. A Bandit wears the "Corsair Outlaw" outift with their [[Aspects|aspect]] varying. Bandits are the second weakest enemies in the overworld of Deepwoken, next to Mudskippers. However, they are among the most diverse enemies, wielding light, heavy, and medium weapons and possessing randomized aspects. ==Moves== A Bandit's arsenal consists of a starter weapon, them being either a [[Battleaxe]], [[Sword]], [[Messer]], [[Mace]] or [[Stiletto]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''

'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] Raises weapon before firmly slamming it down into the ground. [[[Sword]] & [[Messer]]] Reels weapon back before delivering a strong stab.
[[[Stiletto]]] Unleash a quick flurry attack on opponent. *Battleaxe and Mace criticals are not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |} == Finisher== A Bandit executes its opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |[[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] Pins down opponent while raising weapon before firmly bashing the opponent's face. [[[Sword]], [[Messer]] & [[Stiletto]]] Pins down opponent and slices their throat with their blade. |} ==Trivia== *They have turned to a life of crime due to the war in the East, causing jobs to become scarce, as seen in their random dialogues. *"Corsair Outlaw" was created by Renji. *Bandits, despite their reputation of being savage thieves, still have a hierarchy system. Bandits have [[Bandit Leader|leaders]], however they are probably just a stronger bandit. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Bandits]] [[Category:Ambush Enemies]]

(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] Raises weapon above their head before firmly slamming it down into the ground, breaking the victim's guard. [[[Messer]]] Performs a windup before thrusting the blade forward into the enemy's chest.
[[[Gilded Knife]]] Winds up before unleashing a quick flurry of three slashes. *Battleaxe and Mace criticals are not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Feint'''
(★★☆) |Attacks, but stops during the windup in an attempt to catch the opponent off-guard. {{AttackTags |unharmful }} |} == Finisher == A Bandit Leader executes their opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name ! Description |- |Execute |[[[Messer]] & [[Gilded Knife]]] User pins down the opponent and slices their throat with their blade. [[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] User pins down opponent while raising their weapon before firmly bashing the opponent's face in. |} ==Tips== *Parry trade them until their posture breaks. *Alternatively, parry then use your critical. *Try pinning them against a wall and then feinting your next attack before performing a critical. *Feinting and using Mantras can prove quite effective. ==Trivia== *The Bandit Leaders, especially if they wield the Silver Dagger, are infamous for being extremely difficult (at lower levels) on higher ping servers due to the AI's immediate input paired with the speed of daggers, as well as sometimes being able to shred through a player's Blood bar and indirectly kill them that way. *They used to be called "Bandit Captains." {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] [[Category:Bandits]] [[Category:Ambush Enemies]]

|droppable=No
|bankable=No
|value=N/A
|stack=10
|usage=Teleporting to locations within [[The Depths]].}}
==Description==
The '''Baneful Syrinx''' is a consumable [[Relic]] with '''10 uses'''. Baneful Syrinx's usage is teleporting you to various locations within [[Scyphozia]]. Short cooldown upon usage.

Upon usage, the user will be slowed and is prompted to select one of three locations:
# Shrine of the Keeper ([[Temple of Hearts]])
# Cathedral of the Voices ([[Cathedral of the Interstice]])
# Harbinger of the Fall ([[The Diluvian Mechanism]])

A teleportation circle will appear below the user's feet, and after a short delay, you '''and a maximum of 4 other players''' will be teleported directly to your chosen location.
==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:BanefulUI.png
</gallery><gallery>

</gallery>
==Trivia==
*Baneful Syrinx is located in the utility category in your inventory rather than the Relic category.
*Baneful Syrinx was added alongside [[Reciprocal Bonecharm]] and [[Ouroboral Husk]] in the same update, with all three Relics having the same function of teleporting the user to specific locations.
*Baneful Syrinx cannot be used in combat.
*Baneful Syrinx can be used in the Overworld to teleport yourself into The Depths, acting similarly to [[Deepbound|Deepbound's]] Call of the Deep.
*Baneful Syrinx can be used to teleport out of layer 2

==Description==
Bankers are NPCs that a player can utilize to store items across slots. You can also turn [[Artifacts]] to bankers to receive 200 notes and a various assortment of items. Players can also hire bankers inside their guild base to make things easier.

===Safe Deposit Boxes===
Bankers have a unique ability to let the player store items '''across slots''', even if you wiped all your slots, your items would still be there. Items are stored forever until the player takes it out. When accessing the Banking UI by a Banker, players are immune to all forms of outside damage. 

The following item types are sorted as follows: 
*[[Weapons]]
*[[Equipment]]
*[[Treasures]], [[Relics]]
*[[Ingredients]]
*[[Mantra Modifiers]]
*[[Outfits|Outfit Schematics]], [[Enchant Stone]]s, [[Enchant Grease]]s, [[Food]]
[[Enchantments|Enchanted]] items are prioritized first in their respective category.

Players start with six free slots, each holding one item, almost all items can be put inside the bank slots. Soulbound and Relic items will have to go through a '''Vow of Safekeeping,''' where {{c|Knowledge|1}} is spent to create the vow.
<gallery widths="200" position="center">
File:Item Bank Vow of Safekeeping.png
File:Item Bank UI New.png
</gallery>

Each slot will call a small, or large fee depending on how many slots you currently have. The listed prices below apply to every new slot, (e.g, the 15th slot would cost {{c|Notes|2,500}}.)

*0-6, Free (Base Slots)
*7-12, ({{c|Notes|1,000}}) 
*13-17, ({{c|Notes|2,500}}) 
*18-60 ({{c|Notes|5,000}}) 
*61-102 ({{c|Notes|10,000}}). This comes up to a total of 653,500 notes to get all your bank slots.

To put an item in your safe deposit box, you must open your inventory and drag and drop the item you want to deposit into the box. If your box is full and you want to add an item to a stack already present—assuming that stack isn't already at its limit—you'll first need to take out an item that occupies a slot (i.e. equipment) out of it before placing the desired item inside. 

If you need help figuring out how to put an item in a safe deposit box, or just want to see an example of someone depositing, [https://youtu.be/2m4qD3xfOAM here is a great video]. 

====Items requiring a Vow of Safekeeping:====
*[[Weapons]] and [[Equipment]] that are Enchanted, Soulbound, or event exclusive.
*[[Enchant Stone]]
*[[Relics]] (Including Alloys)
*[[Dye Packet]]
*Monster parts required for [[Monster Mantras]]

====Unstorable Items:====
* Certain Unique [[Outfits|Outfit Schematics]]:
**[[Arachnid's Weave]]
**[[Authority Commander]]
**[[Cala-Mariner]]
**[[Jade Vigil's Weave]]
**[[Titanslayer's Adornment]]
**[[Titus's Raiment]]
*[[Kyrsan Medallions]] (Itemized)
*[[Ardour Manifestation]]
*[[Void Feather]]s (Craft it into 3 [[Dark Feather]]s then bank it instead)
*[[Deepshore Fossil]]
*Tools (Repair Hammer, Glider, Etc.)
*Campfires (Store wood instead)
*[[Hallowtide Mask]]
*[[Attunement Potions]] / [[Lotuses]]
*[[Poser's Ring]]
*[[Manor Key]]
*[[Orlandeau's Emerald]]
*[[Pleeksty's Inferno]]
*[[Mantle of Enmity]]

===Account===
Accessing your account will allow you to bank your notes, up to the max of 100,000. However the transaction of notes between slots depend on your level and trading cap (at level 1 you cannot accept more than 940 notes). The banker will inform you of the notes that you have, and will ask if you want to deposit or withdraw. 

==Artifacts==
Players can also give [[artifacts]] to banker NPCs, and in return the player will receive 200 notes and other moderate items, as rare armor, mantra ingredients, weapons, armor schematics, and some XP (the equipment that given can be rarely enchanted).

'''Note: Artifacts can only be turned in via normal bankers, not the ones in your Guild Base.'''

title: Barrel
content:
::''Not to be confused with the weapon, [[The Barrel]].''

[[File:Barrel.png|thumb|A standard Barrel|300px]]
__toc__
==Description==
Barrels are interactable objects that can be picked up, carried, and placed almost anywhere. They are commonly found throughout Lumen and serve a variety of practical purposes.

==Uses==
===Handy Tactics===
Barrels can be used as step stools to gain extra height when the players [[Agility]] is not high enough to reach certain areas. They can also be placed on the ocean’s surface and used as platforms for campfires, allowing players to rest while at sea.

Barrels can be stacked on top of each other to create ladders for areas that would be inaccessible otherwise. This can be done by standing on a placed Barrel and then dropping another near its edge, or by jumping and placing a Barrel midair.

===Barrel Constructions===
Barrels can be stacked in many creative ways beyond simple towers. Players have constructed Barrel tanks, Barrel helicopters, and even by exploiting the game’s physics, '''Barrel launchpads'''. These constructions are typically made by building a three-Barrel tower, removing the lowest Barrel, and building outward from there. Caution is advised though, being launched too fast, too far, or too high can result in death or, in rare cases, a false ban by anti-cheat. Aside from these risks, Barrel constructions are generally safe and serve as a fun activity for bored guilds.

==Trivia==
*Ginormous Barrels bigger than the player can be found at [[The Hidden Village]] and the [[Beloved Zofia]].
*There was an infamous moment of time where green Barrels would spawn throughout [[The Aratel Sea]]. This came from the now cut [[Cut Content#Other|Smuggler Investigation]] mission given by the [[Authority Ensign]] [[Origin]].
*As of June 24th 2026, there were counted in-game to be '''516''' Barrels in the [[Eastern Luminant]], featuring '''21''' unique sizes of Barrels, and '''330''' Barrels in the [[Etrean Luminant]], featuring '''18''' unique sizes of Barrels.
*As of June 25th 2026, there were counted in-game to be '''902''' Barrels in the [[First Layer]] of [[The Depths]], featuring '''9''' unique sizes of Barrels. '''794''' were within the [[City of the Drowned]], while '''108''' were located outside of it.
*Totaling these numbers, there are '''~1,750''' Barrels across the Etrean and Eastern Luminants and the First Layer.

title: Battle Royale
content: {{Location|name=Battle Royale|caption=Starting from scratch, warriors from across Lumen compete to be the last one standing!}} [[File:Kingmaker's Isle.png|center|thumb|900px|Kingmaker's Isle, the unforgiving grounds of Battle Royale, where fresh starts are mandatory and mercy is nowhere to be found]] ==Description== '''Battle Royale''' is a [[World Events|World Event]] that takes place on [[Kingmaker's Isle]] in the [[Open Sea]]. Players spawn with nothing but the bare essentials and must jump off from [[The Floating Keep]] into [[Kingmaker's Isle]] to gather loot, [[Talents]], [[Mantras]] and more to fight their way through the rest to be the last person standing. ==Mechanics== *A shrinking zone similar to the one seen in [[Chime of Conflict]] is always present and functions as such, and is referred to as "the storm". It always closes in on a random location. *You cannot bring a character slot, and instead spawn with a fresh character with a randomized [[Aspects|Aspect]], a [[Gliders|Flimsy Glider]], the {{t|Callout}} [[Talents|Talent]], a [[Sword]], the [[Stranded]] [[Outfits|Outfit]], and fixed [[Attributes]]. **These Attributes are: 50 on every Core Attribute, 100 on every Weapon Attribute and 50 on every Attunement Attribute. *Loot can be found scattered around the map in set locations, with better loot closer to the edge of the map. *[[Talents]] and [[Mantras]] have to be obtained from Deep Totems. *[[Oaths]] are obtained by consuming 3 [[Oath Shards]], which will give you a random Oath, with further Oath Shards progressing your given Oath. All Oaths are available except [[Oath: Saltchemist|Saltchemist]], [[Oath: Silentheart|Silentheart]], [[Oath: Linkstrider|Linkstrider]], and [[Oath: Saintsworn|Saintsworn]]. *You steal all of your opponent's [[Talents]], [[Mantras]] and [[Oaths|Oath]] (if you didn't already have one) upon executing them. *Every once in a while a [[Random Encounters#Resonant_Dawn|Resonant Dawn Meteor]] will fall on a random location that will grant a random [[Resonance]] (no healthpack) to the player that interacts with it, however this takes a while as it locks the user in a lengthy animation in which they cannot act and can be interrupted by other players via damage, making them have to interact with it again if interrupted. **Battle Royale's Resonant Dawn does not spawn a [[Star Knight]]. *Dying will set you to spectate your killer, letting you switch around who to spectate or to return to the Battle Royale lobby. *Reward Eligibility begins when there is at least 20 players in a Battle Royale match. **Obtaining 5 points will award you with a [[Shiva's Codex]] and 2 [[Crowns]]. **Winning will award you with a [[Shiva's Finger]], [[Shiva's Codex]], and 2 [[Crowns]]. *The game "ends" once there is only one group standing. ==Locations== ===[[Kingmaker's Isle]]=== The very map of Battle Royale. In-between sections there is a small town, with plenty of houses. *'''Highly abundant loot, making it a hotspot for looters and fighters.''' ===[[King's Colosseum]]=== A large open colosseum at the center point of the map. *'''Far too little loot and far too much open space, making players near it highly vulnerable.''' ===[[Pillar Peak]]=== A giant temple, near King's Colosseum. *'''Handful of loot, both inside, on the roof, and on a nearby pillar.''' ===[[Hall of Heroes]]=== Another temple opposite of Pillar Peak, with large statues of figures. *'''Decent amount of loot all throughout, with the many trees and structures allowing you to sneak by.''' ===[[Yarix Yard]]=== On the edge of a cliff near the King's Colosseum and Pillar Peak, a small market is located. '''Has a fair amount of loot for its small size, but it can get drained quickly.''' ===[[Valiant Valley]]=== A large valley on the outskirts of the map, featuring many [[Lifevents]] and cliffs. *'''Lacking loot with dead ends and much ground to run on.''' === [[Mount Mavros]] === Higher up within the mountains is Mount Mavros, a small section with a few houses and many cliffs. *'''Medium amount of loot, with tight spaces for combat.''' ===[[Open Sea]] (Coastal areas)=== A small dock rests on the coast, closer to sea level. *'''Abundant loot, but no Healing Orbs and it either tends to get crowded near the end-game or closes you off from the rest.''' ==Loot== ===Chests=== *Gray chests contain [[Outfits#Expert|Expert Outfits]], with the Outfit's name above them. *Orange chests contain [[Outfits#Master|Master Outfits]], with the Outfit's name above them. *Regular chests contain all [[Equipment]] types and [[Oath Shards]]. ===Deep Totems=== Deep Totems are interactable entities that resemble [[Deep Shrines]], albeit much smaller, and are the main way to get [[Talents]] and [[Mantras]]. Interacting with them will lock you in a brief animation before giving you its contents. *Regular/gray Totems give random Common Talents. *Red colored Totems give random {{cl|raretlnf|Rare}} Talents. *Purple colored Totems give random Mantras. ===Healing Orbs=== Green orbs floating above small pedestals can be found around the map, interacting with these will heal you for 20% of your health after a brief action-locking animation, similarly to Deep Totems. ===Weapons=== All of the game's [[Weapons]] can be found scattered around the map, interacting with one will give you a confirmation prompt to equip it. ==Gallery== File:Kingmaker's_Isle.png|Kingmaker's Isle File:King's_Colosseum.png|King's Colosseum File:Pillar_Peak.png|Pillar Peak File:Valiant_Valley.png|Valiant Valley File:Mount_Mavros.png|Mount Mavros File:BattleRoyaleHallowtide.png|Battle Royale during Hallowtide 2023 ==Trivia== *The music for this mode's loading screen is [[Blood And Thunder]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]]. *Every location on the map is territory of [[The Hundred Legions]]. This is because Battle Royale takes place in the [[Luminants#Western_Luminant|Western Luminant]]. *If you spawn with the [[Tiran]] [[Aspects|Aspect]] you still gain the Feathered Glider, which retains its infinite uses and falls slower than the Flimsy Glider. *Battle Royale was originally only accessible to Deepwoken YouTubers during the Content Creator Royale on July 1st, 2023 and it was released to the public on August 25th, 2023 for limited-time testing. *According to Agamatsu in his stream "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eWXZPkM0Xpo&t=7909s Official Deepwoken Youtuber Battle Royale]", the developers were supposedly debating whether or not to make this game mode public due to it potentially "being too much fun" and killing off the main game, thus they decided to restrict the game mode to only weekends. *It is possible to steal an opponent's oath talents and/or passives if they're your first kill (and before you use any oath shards). This can be used to obtain talents like [[Oath: Starkindred|Starkindred's]] Death from Above and Wings passive, while obtaining a seperate oath like [[Oath: Arcwarder|Arcwarder]]. *Surprisingly, regalias aren't disabled in Battle Royale, meaning that characters have a small chance to obtain regalias like Ancient Soul to gain a massive advantage over anybody else early game. == Description ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a [[Twinblades|Twinblade]] weapon in the Medium category. The weapon is covered in round bells with cracked blades made from [[Arkasid|Arkasids]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">Bellmarrow.gif</gallery>

The user twirls the blade around before summoning a rain of bells directly above the target. This hits 7 times, with each hit having a '''0.3x''' scaled damage multiplier. These bells will inflict [[Ironsing]] rods on each of the 7 hits, and will '''autogrip''' the target if they are knocked or at low health.

The critical has a cooldown of '''8 seconds'''.

title: Beloved Zofia
content:
{{PathfinderEx}}
{{Location|name=Beloved Zofia|area=Voidzone|caption=An abandoned ship lost to time, now corrupted by the spirits of the Voidsea.}}
[[File:Beloved Zofia.png|thumb|900px|center]]

== Overview ==
The '''Beloved Zofia''' is a wrecked ship found in the [[Voidsea]] behind [[Minityrsa]]. The ship is similar in appearance to [[The Scoundrel's Bounty]], where the [[Tutorial]] takes place.

== Contents ==
=== [[The Dreadstar]] ===
*Required to speak to for the obtainment of [[Oath: Silentheart|Silentheart]].

=== Ghosts ===
A ghost can appear at the ship's helm. If the player has killed no one, the ghost says, "Remember the dead." However, if the player has killed anyone, the ghost says, "...Did you think we'd forget?" and four weak, short-lived apparitions attack. 
* Speaking to a ghost and fighting them is required for the completion of [[Suyuan]]'s [[Quests|Quest]].

== Potential Enemies ==
{{EnemyGallery
|BrainsuckerIcon.png|Brainsucker
|Kaijufinal.png|Dread Serpent
|Ghost.png|Ghost
|LionfishIcon.png|Lionfish
}}

== Location ==
The Beloved Zofia can be found by hugging the Minityrsa wall and making a left turn at its corner. After turning, keep going straight until the ship is spotted.
<gallery>
Belovedzosiamap.png|Viewpoint on the Map:
</gallery>

== Trivia ==
*While the ''Beloved Zofia'' is not the ship in the tutorial, they share similar - if not the exact same model. The Beloved Zofia is just a slanted version of the [[The Scoundrel's Bounty]]. This is likely just due to them both being the same make of ship.
*The ship is named after the [[w:c:fireemblem:Beloved Zofia|Beloved Zofia]], the signature weapon of Celica in ''Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia.''

Their second move was to hit it until it stopped being a problem |starting attributes=*5 Bloodrend *20 Light Weapon *20 Medium Weapon *20 Heavy Weapon *10 Strength *10 Fortitude *10 Willpower *10 Charisma |final attributes=*30 Bloodrend *100 Light Weapon *100 Medium Weapon *100 Heavy Weapon *75 Strength *50 Fortitude *50 Willpower *25 Charisma |starting traits=*4 Proficiency *2 Vitality |final traits=*8 Proficiency *4 Vitality |allowed weapons=Greatsword, Fist, Greatcannon, Greathammer, Greataxe, Sword, Club, Spear |starting weapons=[[Iron Cestus]], [[Mace]], [[Battleaxe]], [[Steel Maul]], [[Zweihander]] |unlock=Unlocked by default |starting armor=[[Barbarian]]}} ==Description== '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a playable [[Memento]] in the [[Vow of Iron]] gamemode. {{clear}}
==Starting Abilities==
*{{cl|mementotlnf|Until It Is Done}} [Memento Talent] - Your [[Status Effects#Berserk State|Berserk State]] lasts until you willingly end it. *Berserk [Common Talent] - One with nothing to lose has everything to gain. Succomb to burning rage within and enter [[Status Effects#Berserk State|Berserk State]]. **While in the Berserk State, your M1s will nullify your opponent's armor, bypassing it entirely, and your criticals will gain 10% PEN. However, your own armor bars, including Natural Armor, will be drained fully for the duration of the Berserk State. **Berserk can be deactivated after 10 seconds by using the Talent tool again. If you don't meet this Talent's requirements, you will not be able to deactivate it manually. **When activated: ***Your eyes and hair turn red with your eyes gaining a red trail. ***Your armor, including Natural Armor, is immediately removed. These bars will be restored back to their previous values when Berserk ends. ***Padded Armor, Steel Scales, and Lightweight are activated. However, your Basic Attacks activate your opponent's Padded Armor and Steel Scales. ***You benefit from Exposed Durability's 10% damage buff. However, your opponent will also benefit from Exposed Durability if they have the Talent. **The color of the eyes and hair is [[Dye Packet|dyable]].
==Deck of Recollection==
===Starting Deck===
*Brassneck [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Knocking an enemy grants you 20% damage resistance for 15 seconds. (+10 Carry Load) **This '''does''' work on non humanoid monsters, granting you the damage resistance buff on kill. *Enhanced Flow [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Refine your Rush Hour, allowing you to now also gain temp health whenever you hit a player while using Rush Hour. You now also take less damage from Rush Hour. **When you land basic attacks during Rush Hour, gain [[Temporary Health]] equal to 30% of your weapon's scaled damage. ***This cannot give more than 50 Temporary Health in one instance. **This reduces Rush Hour's self damage by 22%, from 4.5 damage per tick to 3.5 damage per tick. **Despite what the description states, this Talent still procs when hitting monsters or other non-player enemies. *Exposed Durability [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Deal 10% more damage to opponents with no armor durability left. **Also affect players with no outfit (Stranded Outfit) **Procs on your Basic Attacks while you have Berserk active. **Also procs on Berserk users. *Perseverance [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Reduces the duration you're [[Status Effects#Ragdolled|Ragdolled]] and [[Status Effects#Unconscious|Unconscious]] for by 25%. (+5 Sanity) **This can stack with other Talents to reduce knock time even further. (Ex. Defiance) *Unwavering Resolve [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Getting parried punishes your posture 33% less. (+2 Posture, +4 Carry Load) **The posture reduction effect is reduced by 0.433% for every point in Strength below 40, having a minimum value of 22.166% posture reduction from being parried at 15 Strength. *{{cl|mementotlnf|Ruinous Recovery}} [Memento Talent] '''{{c|notes|200}}''' - Enemies recover 15% less Posture when parrying. Guardbreaking an enemy by parrying them deals massive damage, and can be done against even the strongest of foes. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Bulldozer}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Enemies you flourish into a wall have a chance of breaking the wall and are guard broken on impact. **This has a 50% chance to break destructible objects when you flourish people into them. *{{Cl|raretlnf|Rush Hour}} [Rare Talent] '''{{c|notes|250}}''' - Stab yourself to become stronger, faster, and deal increased blood bar damage. **Gives you the Rush Hour tool. Can be deactivated at any time by using the tool again. **Drains 4.5 HP per second and 2% Blood per second. **Grants a 15% damage buff, affected by the damage modifier cap. **Increases blood bar damage by +35% (additive). **Grants a 30% active speed boost. This counts for Talent procs. **Recover 5% Blood when dealing damage (0.35s cooldown). Burn damage cannot proc this effect. **If you have the Enhanced Flow Talent, landing basic attacks during Rush Hour will grant [[Temporary Health]], equal to 30% of your weapon's scaled damage. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Vicious Descent (★☆☆) |image=Vicious descent.gif |desc=Leap into the air and slam down with vengeance. |ethercost={{stats|ether|35 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|bld|Blood}} + {{cl|Bleed}} |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''Jump up into the air before slamming down, dealing AoE damage and applying knockdown.'' *Has a base damage of 18.5{{tooltip3|[[Caster Fur Pauldrons|{{cl|equiptlnf|/26}}]]}} per level with innate {{cl|Bleed}} and 2.75 Bloodrend scaling. *Deals 14 posture damage. *Has a 0.75 second windup with a 10 second cooldown. *Has 9.18x PVE scaling *Leaves behind a Blood Pool. *Applies knockdown to the enemy on hit. *This attack apparently has 2 hits. *Feinting this mantra leaves you in the air, but does not restore its cooldown. *Only has 2 scaling *Been testing: Inflicts a flat 15 blood poisoning }} {{MantraInfobox |name=Taunt (☆☆☆) |image=Taunt.gif |mantratype=Support Mantra |desc=Taunt those around you, causing them to be unable to jump and to take 20% more damage. However, they deal +10% more damage. |ethercost={{stats|ether|100 Ether}} |dmgtype=N/A |reqs={{c|notes|250}} |effect=''User taunts their opponent, signified by red particles.'' *Inflicts Taunt for 11{{tooltip3|[[Caster Fur Pauldrons|{{cl|equiptlnf|/12}}]]}} seconds per level. *Affected entities receive 20% more damage, but deal 10% more damage to the caster. **This is applied as a damage modifier to the person hitting the Taunted player. *{{Cl|factiontl|Absolute Force}} [Faction Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Evolve the technique of your Oppressive Force, letting both hits of your flourish deal 50% more posture damage. **Because the second hit of Oppressive Force cannot receive posture damage modifiers, this Talent only benefits the initial hit of your Oppressive Force flourish. *Bear Trap [Common Talent] '''{{c|notes|100}}''' - Landing a hit with your critical against an opponent makes your opponent unable to jump for a duration. Your Natural Armor will resist 10% Physical Damage when active. (+5 Health) **Exoskeleton's resistance will be less effective if you do not meet its Fortitude requirement, losing 0.125% resistance for every point under 40 Fortitude. **Exoskeleton has 443 durability at power 10, scaling up to 600 durability at power 20. **[[Vesperian]]'s Chitin damage reduction stacks multiplicatively with Exoskeleton. **Having both Exoskeleton and Chitin will cause Exoskeleton's durability to take priority, with +200 flat durability added on top, leading to 800 total durability at power 20. **Natural Armor regenerates while resting at a campfire at a rate of 2.2% per 0.2s, aka 11% per second. **Natural Armors are affected by PEN, but its effectiveness is reduced by 75%. (i.e. if someone has 100% PEN, your Natural Armor will resist 7.5% of their damage instead of nothing.) **Natural Armor will lose durability if you get hit by any attack, even if it doesn't resist it. **Natural Armor loss is based on scaled damage received and cannot normally be increased nor decreased by anything, with the exception being damage reductions, like [[Reinforce]], which will reduce the Natural Armor loss. *{{cl|advancedtl|Million Ton Piercer}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - Gain 5% extra PEN and remove the cap on your PEN. Go beyond your limits. **The additional 5% PEN scales with your Strength, only granting the full +5% PEN at 90 Strength. **This removes the 50% Mantra and Weapon PEN cap. *{{cl|advancedtl|Piercing Blow}} [Advanced Talent] '''{{c|notes|350}}''' - Attacks that break an opponent's block ignore their Armor resistances. {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Bloodedge (★☆☆) |image=Bloodrend mantra.gif |desc=Conjure a scythe of blood and swing. |ethercost={{stats|ether|50 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|bloodrend|Blood}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''Quickly conjure up a scythe similar to that of a [[Skyreap Blade]] in a blood red color and rush forward, hitting any target(s) in its way.'' *Deals 16{{tooltip3|[[Caster Fur Pauldrons|{{cl|equiptlnf|/20}}]]}} damage per level, 15 posture, 0.5s windup, has 10s CD at 5 lvl, *Has 9.18x PVE scaling }} {{MantraInfobox |name=Punishment (☆☆☆) |image=Punishment.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Absorb damage then return fury upon your foes. |ethercostesc={{stats|ether|30 Ether}} (Counter), {{stats|ether|30 Ether}} (Slash) |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''User creates a white circle on their torso, if hit during the circle's animation, it'll turn red then proceed to go on a short cooldown. That being said, this attack is still parryable. }} {{MantraInfobox |name=Pressure Blast (☆☆☆) |image=Pressure Blast.gif |mantratype=Combat Mantra |desc=Unleash a powerful pressure blast from the weight of your weapon. |ethercost={{stats|ether|35 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|slash|Slash}} |reqs={{c|notes|700}} |effect=''User performs a heavy downwards swing that cleaves through the air, sending out 3 large blasts of air that ragdoll and knockback.'' *Deals 8{{tooltip3|[[Caster Fur Pauldrons|{{cl|equiptlnf|/10.5}}]]}} base damage per level, per hit (3) with 1.65 Heavy Weapon scaling. *Deals 12 posture damage per hit (3). *Initial hit has a windup of 0.75s with each followup hit having a windup of 0.2s each. *Dazes opponents on hit. *Ragdolls and lightly flings opponents away. *Has Autoparry frames. *Wielding the [[Steel Maul]] will increase the AoE of this Mantra greatly. title: Bestiary
content:
[[File:BestiaryScreen.png|thumb|Bestiary window]] [[File:SharkoBestiaryFull.png|thumb|Megalodaunt's Bestiary entry with all challenges completed]] ==Description== The Bestiary is a part of Deepwoken's Encyclopedia system along with the [[Glossary]]. The Bestiary can be accessed by clicking the book icon labeled "Encyclopedia" at the top left of the screen. The Bestiary grants a damage and defense bonus against monsters and bosses upon completing challenges. Upon defeating eligible [[Monsters]] or [[Bosses]], they will be added to the Bestiary, which tracks progress by showing how many times each has been slain. Defeating the same monster type 10, 25, and 100 times grants increasing damage and defense bonuses against that monster, as well as unlocking bits of lore about it. Defeating the same boss 10 times grants damage and defense buffs against the boss, as well as lore entries. Currently, the Bestiary contains entries for 19 monsters and 10 bosses. Encyclopedia Icon (closed).png|Encyclopedia icon Encyclopedia Icon (open).png|Opened Encyclopedia ==Notes== *Bestiary progress is saved across all slots and the bonuses apply to all slots regardless of your level. *Monster variants count towards and benefit from the original monster's Bestiary. This goes for bosses as well. **For example, defeating a [[King Thresher]] or [[Nightmare Thresher]] will award +1 kill towards the Thresher Bestiary completion, and having progress on the Thresher Bestiary will grant additional damage to these variants as well. *The bonuses tied to each Bestiary entry is '''only applied to that specific enemy''', meaning if you defeat a Brainsucker 100 times, it won't grant you increased damage against Megalodaunts and vice versa. Not even the boss Bestiary buffs are universally applied! *{{cl|corrupted|Corrupt}} Monsters count as '''2 kills''' instead of 1. *'Resilient' Monsters (such as [[Enforcer]]s or [[Bounder]]s) have halved damage and resistance bonuses. **While most monsters are +10% damage/5% resistance per milestone, totaling to +30% damage and +15% resistance, 'resilient' monsters only grant +5% damage and +2.5% resistance per milestone, totaling to +15% damage and +7.5% resistance. ==Bestiary Challenges== ===Monster Tasks=== {| class="article-table fandom-table mw-collapsible" style="width=100%" |+ !
Bestiary !

|bankable=No
|droppable=No
|enchantable=No}}
==Description==
The Big Brother is a LHT weapon in the Dagger category that can be obtained by maxing out the Inquisitor division under the [[Authority Ensign]] origin.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Swift Strike}} procs when you land an M1 on your opponent's back, granting the {{status|Swift Strike}} status effect for an indefinite duration. This status effect changes your next critical attack into a teleporting backstab attack that procs all [[Talents#Assassin|assassination]] Talents and deals percentage based damage.

This has a 20 second cooldown. Using the Swift Strike-enhanced critical consumes the status effect.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:BasicDagger.gif|Base critical without Talent
File:Critical followup (with talent).gif|Critical with Swift Strike Talent
</gallery>Big Brother uses the default Dagger critical, a series of 3 quick slashes. The first hit has a scaled damage multiplier of '''1x''', while the second and third have a scaled damage multiplier of '''0.8x'''.

When landing an M1 on your opponent's back, apply the Swift Strike Status effect, drastically changing your critical attack. On critical, the user briefly flashes out of the frame before reappearing behind their opponent's backs and deeply gashing them. Deals percentage based damage and procs all [[Talents#Assassin|assassination]] Talents.

The default Dagger critical has a cooldown of '''3 seconds''', while the Swift Strike Talent has a cooldown of '''20 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
Big Brother Full.png|Full view
</gallery>

==Trivia== 
*Its name is a direct reference to the fictional character "Big Brother" from the novel ''Nineteen Eighty-Four'' by George Orwell, signifying the concept of constant, oppressive governmental or authoritative surveillance and control over a population.
*Swift Strike is not a "critical," meaning things such as [[Warmaster's Medallion]] or {{t|Critical Engine}} with [[Blessed Gem]] cannot reduce its cooldown.

== Description ==
The '''Black Death''' is the sister of its [[Red Death|red counterpart]], a tool of the Ministry which does not care about the mess it leaves behind.

==Talents==
{{text|wtal}}

{{etal|weapon|Corporeal Dissolution}} applies {{status|Wither}} on any weapon attack that drains Ether, with the amount applied scaling on the amount of Ether drained. This is capped at 10 Wither per proc.

== Critical ==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:BlackDeathStanding.gif|Standing Critical
File:BlackDeathRunning.gif|Running Critical
</gallery>The Black Death has two criticals.

For the standing critical, the user raises the spear, summoning six stakes of shadow wherever the user is facing. These stakes solely inflict Shadow.

For the running critical, the user rapidly thrusts the spear while slowly moving forward, ending with a final blow that inflicts Shadow. The user then raises their hand, summoning three stakes that also inflict Shadow.

Both criticals have a cooldown of '''8 seconds.'''

{{text|m1leg2}}

==Trivia==
* Unlike the '''Red Death''' which is refered to as a spear, the '''Black Death''' is refered to as a pike.
* Before the limit on the amount of Wither its Talent could apply per proc, stacking enough ether drain effect could result in large amount of Wither being applied in one hit, sometimes outright one shotting players by turning their entire health bar into Wither.
