They also deal +10% more damage to Monsters. *{{cl|raretlnf|Defiance}} - Negative Status effects are halved when Black Divers are below 35% HP. *Last Resort - Black Divers gain +10% damage while below 25% HP. *Steady Footing - Black Divers resist knockback effects and do not slide on ice. *Suffocating Impact - Black Divers apply Suffocation and Winded after a wall bang. *Heavy Hitter - Black Divers deal +10% posture damage with heavy weapon basic attacks. *{{cl|raretlnf|Concussion}} - Being flourished into a wall by a Black Diver alter vision and Daze for longer. *Static Link - Black Divers landing a Flourish or Uppercut apply a static link. *Storm Link - Black Divers apply Shock (Surge because of Surge Path) to enemies with a static link if hit with a Wind mantra. *{{cl|raretlnf|Chronostasis}} - Black Divers put target's Resonance on a short cooldown when they land hits. *{{cl|oathtlnf|Protagonist Syndrome}} - The grasp of shadow is meaningless in the face of the Black Diver's blinding light. The Black Diver's Dawnwalker mantras are empowered after being hit by Shadowcast. *{{cl|oathtlnf|Luminous Flash}} - After dealing a certain amount of damage while in "Absolute Radiance", the Black Diver gains a chance to empower their strikes with pure light. *{{cl|oathtlnf|Absolute Radiance}} - Dealing damage with Dawnwalker mantras briefly makes the Black Diver's immune to all elemental effects for a short period. == Finisher == A Black Diver executes its opponent after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" ! [⁣[[Markor's Inheritor]] & [[Pale Morning]]] Pins down opponent while raising weapon before firmly bashing the opponent's face. |} == Tips == * Fight them like any other humanoid NPC with a weapon. * Their wide moveset requires a bit of getting used to. Thankfully, these NPCS aren't very common. * Remember that killing these guys will take some time; they have 10,000 health. * Can take on most [[Monsters]] in [[The Depths]] due to their (fittingly) large health pool. == Gallery == File:BlackDiverNPC2.png|With an enchanted Weapon == Trivia == *Originally, Black Divers replaced the Divers Guards at Castle Light to improve its safety, they were however replaced with [[Journeymen Diver|Journeymen Divers]] on January 16th, 2023 due to their presence contradicting the established low number and high power level of actual Black Divers. **They then went unused until the May 15th, 2023 update, which brought [[Faction Ambushes]], which reintroduced them as part of high level ambushes. *If you talk to one in [[The Understrand]], they will begin attacking you as the only way you can find one there is if you have bad [[Reputation]] with The Divers. *They are one of the few enemies that use [[Oaths]], with the other enemies being the [[Ignition Union Arcwarder]], [[Subtle Knife of Eylis]], [[Old Knife of Eylis]], [[Ministry Enforcer]], and [[Iblis, The Fallen Angel|all]] [[Abaddon, Sinner of Ice|four]] [[Minos, Sinner of Flame|Starkindred]] [[Astaroth, Sinner of Wind|enemies]]. *They use both variants of [[Thundercall|Jolt Grab]], that being the Magnet Spark variant and the base version. *Curiously, [[The Hundred Legions]] are hostile towards them. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Enemies that can wield Enchantments]] [[Category:Enemies with Oaths]] [[Category:Diver Enemies]] [[Category:Black Divers]]

==Description==
The '''Black Diver Hoodie''' was a hoodie released as part of a Deepwoken and Makeship collaboration. Classified under the "Hoodies" category, it was based on the [[Black Diver]] [[Outfits|Outfit]]. Its campaign ran from July 18th, 2025, to August 16th, 2025, before selling out. The hoodie was designed to be unisex and was made from 41% cotton, 57% polyester, and 2% other fibers, excluding decorative details.


===Official Description===
<poem style="text-align: center">
"Eclectic, strange, but a vital part of the Divers' mission, the Black Divers are idiosyncratic pioneers.

Equip the uniform of a Black Diver, pull your hood up, and steel yourself against the horrors of your ears getting cold.

Prove to the outside world that your sanity is very much intact."
</poem>

title: Black Divers division
content:
{{Spoiler}} {{Factions |image1=Silhouette.jpg |leader=*[[Deukalion Akarad]] (deceased){{Ref/Book|The Song of Fathoms / Oscillation}}
*[[The High Convocation]] |territory=[[The Depths]], [[Castle Light]] |goals=*Exploring and setting up bases in [[the Depths]].
*Sending expeditions to the the Depths.}} __TOC__ ==Description== '''The Black Diver Division''' are the highest rank of [[the Divers]]. The division was formed some time between 57 CE and 59 CE as the Citadel Divers' senior members evolved into their own rank. While [[The Citadel of Markor|the Citadel]] was actively recruiting, Black Diver agents would be sent on surface missions around the [[Luminants#Central Luminant|Central Luminant]], with the goal of potentially finding a cave system that would physically connect to [[the Depths]]. In 1272 CE{{Deep dates|Verse2}} [[Chaser]], a Black Diver, betrayed [[the Divers]]. Chaser sided with [[the Ministry]] and killed all Divers participating in the expedition to the [[Second Layer]]. ==Members== '''[[Deukalion Akarad]]''': A member of [[the Divers]], active shortly after its founding. Akarad was the first leader of the Black Divers and was known to Diver recruits as "father Diver". Akarad was among those who perished during the first Depths expedition of [[the Divers]], though his notes were able to reach [[Surface|the Surface]]. '''[[Akira]]:''' An [[Etrean]] with the rank of Black Diver. He has been a part of the organization for almost 10 years now. He wields a katana and possess a [[Resonance]] in the form of a bell, granting him the ability to explode the heads of his foes. This bell is corrupted, with every use taking from his lifespan. The time taken, if it even drains in time, rather than from a pool of his lifeforce, scales on the strength of those it is used on, allowing him to use it on lots of weak enemies with little consequences. He can be found in [[the Depths]] by a tree and a ruined building, reading his book. He will be interrupted by a group of Ignition Union workers, whom he disposes of with relative ease using his Resonance. The player can talk to him and, with the right dialogue options, be allowed to join [[The Divers]] [[Guilds|Guild]] and unlock the [[Deepbound]] [[Origins|Origin]] if they can reach him at [[Castle Light]]. '''[[Amorus Pleeksty]]:''' As a former Black Diver, Pleeksty still kept loose connections with the Divers but mainly pursued his individual research until he went missing. He is most likely residing currently in the Third Layer of [[The Depths]], also known as The Vents. In his time as a Black Diver, he was the first to venture into the Third Layer (and currently is the only one that has done so) and consumed a part of the Drowned God of Fire, [[Korilfiend, the Inferno's Provenance|Korilfiend]], in the form of a flower, causing him to become a '''[[Deepwoken]]''' and ascend to a near-godlike state. This newfound enlightenment allowed him to become the first true [[Flamecharm]]er, refining the art of pyromancy into what is commonly used today. He would then go on to establish a group known as “[[The Covenant of Flame]]”, a group of passionate [[Flamecharm]]ers who wish to follow the same path as Amorus Pleeksty, almost religiously studying his books and practicing his teachings such as the [[Talents#Amoran Seeker|Flame Within]]. Pleeksty, however, has come to think little of them, only now seeing them as a fan club. He would later join [[the Divers]] but would disappear into the Vents once more. Despite his tremendous power and age, he is described as a "chill" guy; if anyone encounters him, Pleeksty will most likely be very amicable. '''[[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]:''' Chaser is an [[Adret]] Black Diver who secretly possesses the gift of hemokinesis, granted to him by the Second Prophet of [[the Ministry]] in order to achieve his true goals. He was a Black Diver that volunteered to lead an expedition into the Second Layer but would later reveal that he had betrayed the Divers long ago. With the assistance of the native [[Kyrsgarde]], Chaser murdered all the Divers who went with him in the original expedition he was a part of.{{Ref/Book|Diver's Journal: Apprentice Azel}} He then slaughtered the other Divers that were involved in expeditions following that one.{{Ref/Book|Diver's Journal: Journeyman Skeli}}{{Ref/Book|Diver's Journal: Apprentice Hero}} The players later encounter him as the boss of the First Floor of the Second Layer. He is for all intents and purposes Ministry aligned, having been a man on the inside for them for years, though had genuinely been a Diver at the start. '''[[Funke, Master of Thunder]] and [[Nell, Master of Frost]]:''' Funke and Nell wear Black Diver uniforms. Nell can be found at [[Etris]] and Funke at [[Summer Isle]]. Not a lot is known about these two and the reason behind being stationed on the surface, as there is no dialogue or a way to ask them about it. '''[[Carrion, Father of Evolution]] (Dr. Diver):''' Carrion (also referred to as “Dr Diver”) is a [[Ganymede]] Black Diver who is very skilled in terms of alchemy and science, being able to give people the abilities of certain [[monsters]] at the cost of the corresponding creature’s organs. Despite being a Black Diver, he is also the leader of The Apothecary, a group based on the creation and research of potions and some other scientific topics. This branch was later excommunicated from the Divers due to the actions of an undisclosed individual. He is not a combatant, rather a scientist. His objective is to create the Moonseye Vigor and be able to "transcend" everyone by drinking this potion. Carrion already drank a prototype of the Moonseye Vigor, which drove him to insanity, along with giving him green eyes. He is currently residing in Castle Light but can also be seen in [[Second Layer/New Kyrsa|the Great Library of New Kyrsa]], probably researching to create a new Moonseye Vigor. Apparently, he doesn't care much for the events of [[Second Layer|The Second Layer]], instead choosing to prioritize his research of the Vigor rather than preventing the awakening of a drowned god that could destroy [[Lumen]]. This characteristic, alongside Klaris’ dialogue about him, tells us that Carrion prioritizes his research above everything else, giving little to no care about any major events in the game that doesn't assist his studies. ==Trivia== ==References== [[Category:The Divers]] [[Category:Black Divers]]

Did you need something?|author=Blacksmith}} {{NPCInfobox |image1= File:Caragan.png|Etris File:Baragan.png|Isle of Vigils File:CastleLightBlacksmith.png|Castle Light File:VoidheartBlacksmith.png|Voidheart File:Guild base blacksmith.png|Guild Base File:Summer Isle blacksmith.png|Summer Isle File:Greathive Aratel Blacksmith.png|Greathive Aratel File:Fort Merit Blacksmith.png|Fort Merit File:Meteor Isle blacksmith.png|Meteor Isle File:Rudral.png|Miner's landing File:Louie Spellhardt.png|Floating Keep |name= *Etris: [[Caragan]] *Isle of Vigils: [[Baragan]] *Miner's Landing: [[Rudral]] *The Floating Keep: [[Louie Spellhardt]] |aspect=*Etrean *Vesperian *Chrysid *Capra *Gremor *Lightborn *Celtor |location= *[[Etris]] *[[Isle of Vigils]] *[[Summer Isle]] *[[Greathive Aratel]] *[[Fort Merit]] *[[Miner's Landing]] *[[Meteor Isle]] *[[Castle Light]] *[[The Floating Keep]] *[[Voidheart]] *[[Guild Bases]] |pronouns=He/him }} ==Description== {{PAGENAME}} are stationary NPCs found in numerous towns across Lumen. They are the primary station used to craft and manage [[Outfits]]. They are also the leading source of [[Cloth]] and [[Fiber]], essential to craft Outfits, as well as selling utility tools. Blacksmiths have 3 functions: opening the [[Outfits]] menu, crafting [[Seasonal Medals]], and exchanging [[Ore|Pure Ores]] for moderate-tier loot. Additionally, they sell: *[[Cloth]] for {{c|notes|6}} *[[Fiber]] for {{c|notes|3}} *[[Coal]] for {{c|notes|15}} *[[Pickaxe]] for {{c|notes|3}} *[[Lumber Axe]] for {{c|notes|3}} *[[Flint]] for {{c|notes|3}} *[[Ores|Iron]] for {{c|notes|20}} *[[Ores|Gold]] for {{c|notes|50}} Blacksmiths will refuse to service the player if their [[reputation]] is too low with the faction of the location they're at. ===To craft an outfit=== *The blue highlighted text is the schematics you have on hand, if you press '''Learn''', the outfit will move to the recipe that it belongs to. * An outfit recipe retains the requirements, stats, Talent description (if it has a Talent) as well as the outfit description. *If you have multiple crafted outfits, the current one will be an orange color while the rest will be a bolded white. *Repairing durability is free. ====Transmogging outfits==== ''More info: [[Transmogrification]]'' *If you have more than one outfit crafted, pressing '''Transmog''' will allow you to transmogrify currently equipped outfit with any other outfit you've crafted, wearing the '''appearance''' of the selected outfit but keeping the '''stats''' of your currently equipped one. [[File:Transmog UI 222.png|thumb|none]] ===To turn in pure ores=== *Press the second option with a pure ore in hand. ** Pure Iron is not able to be turned in. **Erisore chests are the plain wooden chests, and they usually give blindfolds among other Erisia loot. **If you turn in a pure ore 5 times, you get the excavator Talent. ===Craft event items with Knowledge=== * You are able to craft limited-time items using [[Knowledge]] if you bought [[Seasonal Medals]] during a [[Events|Deepwoken event]], such as Hallowtide Medals 22, 23 and 24 from [[Lysander Spellhardt]] during Hallowtide. You can also craft the [[Party Hat]] obtained by joining during the [[Festival of a Billion Souls]] mini event in 2024. ** You can craft outfits, weapons, and even enchants and mantras that were from these events. ==Shop== {{ShopTable|newtable|newset |title=Smithy's Supplies |name=Cloth |currency=Notes |price=6 |desc=Useful for a bit of tailoring. }} {{ShopTable |name=Fiber |currency=Notes |price=3 |desc=Spun into thread or woven into cloth for tailoring. }} {{ShopTable| |name=Coal |currency=Notes |price=15 |desc=Used for fuel and in the production of steel. }} {{ShopTable| |name=Iron |currency=Notes |price=20 |desc=A crucial ore in blacksmithing, foundational to hundreds of alloys. }} {{ShopTable|end |name=Gold |currency=Notes |price=50 |desc=A rare and precious ore found deep beneath the ground. }} {{ShopTable|newtable|inset |title=Smithy's Tools |name=Pickaxe |currency=Notes |price=3 |desc=You'll be needing one to get the ores for stronger armor. }} {{ShopTable |name=Lumber Axe |currency=Notes |price=3 |desc=A sturdy axe for felling trees. }} {{ShopTable|end|endset |name=Flint |currency=Notes |price=3 |desc=A sharp flint and a scrap of pyrite used for starting fires. }} ==Dialogue== |-|Base Dialogue= {{#tag:tabber|Good & Neutral Reputation= {{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;" {{!}} colspan="12" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue {{!}}- {{!}} colspan="12" {{!}}Oh? title: Blacksteel Pirate
content:
{{EnemyInfobox|title1=Blacksteel Pirate|health=420|drops=*[[Blacksteel Helm]] *[[Blacksteel Pauldrons]] *[[Darksteel Greatsword]]|weapon=*[[Darksteel Greatsword]] *[[Battleaxe]] *[[Sword]] *[[Messer]] *[[Mace]]|moves=*Strong Left *Rapid Punches *Shadow Assault *Pressure Blast *Exhaustion Strike|image1=Blacksteel pirate.png|caption1=I could've been a hero…}} ==Description== Blacksteel Pirates can be found in [[The Etrean Sea]]. They spawn in groups of 5 in the [[Random Encounters|Water Tower event]] and can be encountered on islands during Sea Events in groups of five or four depending on the island. They wear a [[Darksteel Plate]] and a dyed black [[Silver Knight's Helm]]. ==Moves == Their arsenal consists of either a [[Darksteel Greatsword]], [[Battleaxe]], [[Sword]] or a [[Mace]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] Raises weapon before firmly slamming it down into the ground. [[[Sword]]] Performs a windup before thrusting blade forward.
[[[Darksteel Greatsword]]] Enters a stance before rushing forward and performing a quick upward strike. *Battleaxe and Mace criticals are not blockable. Darksteel Greatsword critical deals high posture damage. *Battleaxe critical has hyperarmor during the windup animation. Darksteel Greatsword critical has true hyperarmor during the full animation. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y |type2_color = DarkRed }} |- |
'''Strong Left'''
(★★☆) |A powerful, flinging punch that shatters the air. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |- |
'''Rapid Punches'''
(★★☆) |User unleashes a barrage of blows at their opponent. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Shadow Assault'''
(★★☆) |Windup before turning invisible and dashing forward, dealing very minor damage to anyone in front of caster while applying darkness. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, movement }} |- |
'''Pressure Blast'''
(★★☆) |A heavy downwards swing that cleaves through the air, sending out 3 large blasts of air that ragdoll and knockback. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll }} |- |
'''Exhaustion Strike'''
(★☆☆) |A melee strike that transfers their posture damage on hit. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} === Talents === * {{cl|raretlnf|Bulldozer}} - Enemies you flourish into a wall have a chance of breaking the wall and are guard broken on impact. * Shield Breaker - Blunt damage now deals full posture damage to shields. * Unwavering Resolve - Getting parried punishes your posture 50% less. * Bear Trap - Landing a hit with your critical against an opponent makes your opponent unable to jump for a duration. Also slows your opponent. * Fear the Dark - Enemies will briefly hang in place when they run from you. * Uproar - When hit 3 or more times within 3 seconds go into an uproar where you cannot be stunned for a short duration. Landing a hit on another player will end your Uproar. == Finisher== A Blacksteel pirate executes the player after knocking them: {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Execute |[[[Battleaxe]], [[Darksteel Greatsword]] & [[Mace]]] Pins down opponent while raising weapon before firmly bashing the opponent's face. [[[Sword]] & [[Messer]]] Pins down opponent and slices their throat with their blade. |- |Drown |Since they do not have the Fishman Talent, when you are knocked out in the water, they will spam mantras at you, eventually most likely drowning you in the water. It is possible to survive this with the help of Talents such as Scuba Drowner and Impervious Slumber. |} ==Tips== *The Darksteel Greatsword Blacksteel Pirates pose the biggest threat to rookie players; only engage if you know how to parry the critical. *They essentially act as very much high-risk reward types for lower-level players who want to earn exp and items quickly. *They may be more difficult than bandits as if you don't know how to parry, you will get combo'ed. *If you grip them close to the wooden tower, the other Blacksteel Pirates will be alerted, and you might get interrupted. Instead, carry the Blacksteel Pirate's body into the ocean; they will drown, and any other Blacksteel Pirates will not be alerted. *Be extremely cautious if you are knocked out in the water, as Blacksteel Pirates will use Rapid Punches on your body even if you are knocked out in the water, which you end up drowning. Even if you have Scuba Drowner, the Blacksteel Pirates will still use Rapid Punches even if your knocked out reducing your odds of survival to a bare minimum. ==Trivia== *Since they originate from below the ocean and they use [[Shadowcast]], they possibly are connected with [[The Depths]] or [[The Ministry]]. *The Tower Event drops 2 chests. First, at the top of the tower and the second can only be obtained when tower sinks as it is blocked by blocks. *They don't actually wear a [[Blacksteel Helm]] or [[Blacksteel Pauldrons]], despite being able to drop them and sharing their namesake, "Blacksteel". *If no one attacks the Wooden Tower, the Blacksteel Pirates will despawn, but the top of the tower will still spawn a chest and the Wooden Tower will sink. *The Wooden Tower can despawn while someone's actively fighting the pirates, not granting any XP and not spawning the chest at the bottom of the tower. *They strangely have the [[Cut Content#Uproar|now removed talent]] Uproar, which was removed on the 19th of Janurary 2025 update {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]]

It deals constant damage and ether drain per second to anyone who stands in it. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |} ==Passives== *'''Perpetual Speed Boost''' - The Blacksteel Pirate Captain moves incredibly fast at all times. Running is not an option. ==Tips== *It is highly recommended that you take out all of the [[Blacksteel Pirate]]s first before attempting to fight the Blacksteel Pirate Captain. *As it is not required to kill them for the mission to complete, it may be more advisable to simply assassinate them or distract them using other enemies and then grab the hostage and run. {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]]

title: Blade Instructor
content:
{{CutContent}} {{EnemyInfobox |title=Blade Instructor |image1=Blade Instructor.png |caption1=I am going to beat you to death |health=300 |drops=None |weapon=*[[Battleaxe]] *[[Sword]] *[[Mace]] *[[Iron Spear]] |moves=*Assault *Critical }} ==Description== The Instructor was an NPC that can only spawned in via sparring. To spawn him, the player had to talk to [[Das]], only then would an Instructor spawn. Instructors wore a [[Gladiator Helm]] and a [[Cloak of Winds]] outfit with their [[Aspects|aspect]] varying. With the introduction of [[Training Mode]], they were rendered obsolete and removed. ==Moveset== An Instructor's arsenal consisted of either a [[Battleaxe]], [[Sword]], [[Mace]] or [[Iron Spear]]: {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |[[[Battleaxe]] & [[Mace]]] Raises weapon before firmly slamming it down into the ground. [[[Sword]]] Performs a windup before thrusting blade forward.
[[[Iron Spear]]] Enters a stance before performing a quick swipe with spear, will perform an additional short lunge if the first hit lands. *Battleaxe and Mace criticals are not blockable. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |- |
'''Feint'''
(★★☆) |Attacks, but then stops mid-way to catch the player off guard. {{AttackTags |unharmful, misc }} |} ==Finisher== If the Instructor is the one that downs the player they will disappear and the player will receive all of their health back, although they will not regain any blood. However, if the player is downed by any other means, the Instructor will grip the player like any other NPC. {| class="fandom-table" !Name !Description |- |Disappear |Unequips weapon before disappearing into thin air. |} ==Trivia== *The Instructor could be killed by using moves that instantly grip opponents when they are on low HP, using certain moves, like Mani Katti, and employing burn. You could also grip him with help of the [[Poser's Ring]] with a [[Katana]] or [[Shattered Katana]], dealing enough damage and then sheathing your katana will knock him and you can grip him.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMiY1IgUpJo *The [[Blade Temple Guard]]s did not react should an Instructor be gripped near them. *Defeating one sometimes grants positive [[reputation]] with the [[Kingdom of Etrea]], usually when you don't get a health pack from killing them. *Gripping them would prompt them to say 'Hey, what do you think you're doing?!' *You could glitch an instructor by starting the spar and not doing anything at all. To fix it, you just needed to defeat them. *There was a secret text bubble that appears if the player is knocked due to hunger or other means while in a battle with him that says "Not bad, but not good enough," which could be due to the Instructor being meant to knock the player. ==References== {{History}} [[Category:Enemies]] [[Category:Etrea Enemies]]

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage dealing [[enchantment]] that applies burn to your opponent.

Blazing's flame particle color changes depending on your [[Flamecharm]] color, turning blue if you have {{t|Azure Flames}} or black if you have {{t|Wraith Path: Twisted Puppets}}.

==Effect==
After landing enough weapon hits, {{PAGENAME}} applies [[burn]] to your opponent on all weapon attacks for the next 5 seconds. This has a 10 second cooldown.

The hit count required to proc this enchantment varies based on your weapon type, requiring 3 hits for [[Light Weapons]], 2 hits for [[Medium Weapons]], and 1 hit for [[Heavy Weapons]].

===Notes===
*If you have {{t|Lava Serpent}}, this enchantment will proc Eruptions instead of applying burn. Eruptions have a 3 second cooldown.
*If you have {{t|Twisted Puppets}}, this enchantment will apply 'Puppet Burn,' spawning Puppets every 4 seconds and draining Ether.
*Like all other sources of [[burn]], Blazing's burn scales on your [[Flamecharm]] investment and is affected by all of your burn Talents.
**Base burn has a DPS of 8 at 0 Flamecharm, scaling up to 12 DPS at 100 Flamecharm. More information how Talents and other effects affect your burn damage can be found on the [[Flamecharm#Trivia|Flamecharm]] page.
*Blazing adds a separate instance of '''1''' flat Flamecharm damage to your attacks as hitregistry for burn. This procs even if Blazing hasn't procced yet and if your opponent is in burn immunity or your Eruptions are on cooldown.
**Because of this, you can use this enchantment to change your opponent's {{t|Everchanging Aegis}} type to Flamecharm resistance, allowing the first hit of your non-Flamecharm attuned attacks to deal 10% more damage against players using this Talent.
*This enchantment reduces the need for Talents that apply burn, such as {{t|Flaming Flourish}}, especially on heavy weapons.

title: Blessed Gem
content: {{ItemTemplate |image=Blessed Gem.png |value=80 |weight=1 |stack=25 |type=Deep Gem |rarity=Legendary |desc=A frequency emits from within like a choir... ---- On hit, reduces the cooldown of a Mantra by 50%. (5s CD) |obtainment= *[[Primadon]] *[[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] *[[Chaser]] *[[Scion of Ethiron]] *[[Ferryman]] *[[Lodestar|Lodestar Bounty]] job *[[First Layer]] *[[Sea Events]] *[[Fishing]] *[[Cinders of Etris]] *[[Deep Crucible]] *[[Widow's Wail Cemetery#Trial of the Gourdskipper|Trial of the Gourdskipper]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *[[Saramaed Hollow]] {{iv|Vow of Iron}}: *Found in {{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} *{{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} chests}} ==Description== The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a teal diamond-shaped [[Deep Gem]]. ==Effect== File:Blessed.gif Upon landing a Mantra with a Blessed Gem equipped, the cooldown of your Mantra will instantly be halved. If the Mantra only starts its cooldown once it ends, the cooldown will only be halved if the final part of the Mantra lands. This effect has a 5 second cooldown. ===Notes=== *This Gem is best used on high cooldown Mantras. *If you have the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}} from the [[Grilled Parasol Brain]], {{PAGENAME}}'s cooldown reduction will be increased from -50% seconds to -66%. *Mantras with a 10 second base cooldown will have full efficiency with Blessed Gem, as they'll come off cooldown just as Blessed Gem does. **With the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}}, a 15 second cooldown Mantra will nearly have full efficiency with Blessed Gem, coming off cooldown just 0.1 seconds after Blessed Gem does. *[[Dread Whisper]] in specific is exceptionally good when paired with this Gem due to its gimmick requiring you to land it several times in a row. **On the other hand, Mantras that can reset their own cooldowns (e.g. [[Restrain]] or [[Slice 'n' Dice]]) will not be as good when paired with this Gem, it is highly recommended that you use a different Gem for them instead. *For usage with {{t|Critical Engine}}; **This Gem, naturally, halves your critical cooldown on hit. This is best used for criticals have have a cooldown of 10 seconds or higher. **You can pair this Gem with the [[Warmaster's Medallion]] to gain a total 55-60% cooldown reduction on your weapon critical, lowering a 25 second critical cooldown to 11.25-10 seconds. ***And when paired with the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}}, you'll have up to 69.4-72.8% cooldown reduction, lowering a 25 second critical cooldown to a mere 7.65-6.8 seconds. **Due to [[Mantle of Enmity]] counting as a critical attack for Talent effects, {{t|Critical Engine}} Blessed Gem can proc on it, though it will halve your regular critical cooldown instead of the Mantle's. ***This can be used to halve the cooldown of critical attacks that do not deal damage (e.g. [[Vortex Echo]] or [[The Weaving Web]]). **The critical cooldowns of certain weapons are not considered "critical cooldowns." For example, [[Big Brother]]'s Swift Strike Talent and [[Krulian Knife]]'s Krulian Charge critical will not have their cooldowns reduced if used with Blessed Gem {{t|Critical Engine}}. ==Crafting== This Gem can also be used to craft a variety of items. *[[Outfits]]: [[Authority Commander]] and [[Black Diver]]. {{History}} [[Category:Treasures]] [[Category:Mantras]] [[Category:Deep Gems]]

==Description==
The {{PAGENAME}} is an [[Equipment]] item under the "Face" category.

The {{t|Blinded}} Talent applies the {{status|b=y|Blinded}} effect to the wearer, heavily reducing their vision. This, or the [[Blind]] Flaw, is a requirement to obtain the [[Blindseer]] Oath.

==Trivia==
*Model wise, the Crimson and Black blindfold are visually the exact same, just with different colors.
*[[Gremor]] get a small circle of clear vision around them when affected by the Blinded Talent.
*The {{t|Blinded}} Talent originally made the screen completely black so the user could not see anything other than chat messages and the GUI.
*Many players used this to troll freshies by tricking them into equipping it, as the blindfold could not be removed without a campfire, removing it through the inventory, or equipping another piece of face equipment. Since finding a campfire was extremely difficult while completely blinded, many unsuspecting players would end up stranded. (At least back then.)

{{History}}

==Description==
The Blizzard Ring is a craftable [[Relic]] Ring that slows all enemies hit by M1s and {{status|Suffocate|suffocates}} those you flourish. You also gain 15 Ether when you land [[Galebreathe]] or [[Frostdraw]] attacks.

Its effects are the combined powers of both the [[Frost Ring]] and the [[Gale Enhanced Ring]].

The Blizzard Ring can be crafted at the [[Lost Forge]] with a [[Frost Ring]], [[Gale Enhanced Ring]], and a [[Shiva's Codex]].

title: Blood Scourge
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Conjure a swirling mass of chaotic energy that will drain the life out of your foes.|author=Blood Scourge description}}
{{Resonance|effect=Executes all knocked entities within radius.|appearance=Red circle appears around center of use.|
image1 =<gallery> 
File:Blood Scourge.gif|Blood Scourge
File:Blood Scourge Card.png|Card
File:Blood Scourge Corrupt Card.png|Corrupt
</gallery>}}
==Description==
'''Blood Scourge''', also referred to as '''Reaper,''' is a [[Resonance]] or "bell" that players can obtain and is uncommon to roll.
===''Appearance''===
When used, a red circle appears around the user or projectile. Any unconscious entities or players in this area are immediately gripped.
==Usage==
Pressing {{Input|keybind|resonance}} will activate the '''Blood Scourge''' Resonance. '''This combat tags the user.'''

'''Blood Scourge''' will near instantly execute any unconscious entity within it's range (even allies) and will recover some of the player's HP depending on the level and health of the target, occurs within a few seconds. It has a cooldown of about 20 seconds. The execution cannot be avoided once in range, unless the caster is attacked at the very start of the animation, or the target was picked up and moved out of the circle.

{{cl|corres|If Blood Scourge is corrupted, it can be charged by holding {{Input|keybind|resonance}}, which prevents the user from moving but sends all executed targets to The Depths. This roughly takes three seconds to charge. Can be negated if the user is hit while charging. Additionally, after executing a player with Corrupted Blood Scourge (regardless of charge), you will gain a 50% buff to incoming healing for 30 seconds.}}

==='''''Resonance Point usage'''''===
When obtained, Blood Scourge will spend its points on the following stats:

*'''Thrown:''' If this stat is used, the player will launch a projectile ahead that then summons the AOE to grip entities. (The thrown version cannot be canceled)
*'''Range:''' The more points are spent on this stat, the further the range of the AOE becomes at the expense of a slower grip duration.
*'''Healing:''' The more points are spent on this stat; the more health given per grip.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
ReaperVariant1.png|Standing variant
ReaperVariant2.png|Throwing variant
</gallery>

==Trivia==
*The Blood Scourge Resonance does NOT give you hyperarmor while doing the animation, you can get cancelled while doing it if other players/NPCs attack you.
*Unlike the standing variant, throwable Blood Scourge cannot be cancelled.
*Shortly after the mechanic was added, Corrupted Blood Scourge could send people below Power 12 to The Depths. This was quickly patched.
*Most likely a reference to Dinakeri's/Wraith Knight's Soul Rip skill from Rogue Lineage, which itself is a reference to the [[w:c:darksouls:Dark_Hand|Dark Hand]] from the ''Dark Souls'' franchise.
*The sound that plays once using the Resonance originates from a 2012 meme: https://youtu.be/TS_VIVVmTTE?t=3

It is found as an exceedingly rare (~0.5% per Chest) drop from [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]]. The {{t|Cauterized Wounds}} Talent reduces blood bar damage taken from taking damage. It does not affect blood ''drain'' effects such as [[Bloodrend]]. When equipped, even while its visibility is toggled off, the crown has swirling blood effects that are drawn towards the gem. ==Gallery== Bloodforged Crown Particles.gif|Particles Bloodforged anim.gif|Particles (Head Toggled) Better picture of bloodforged crown.png|Without Gremor Horns Bloodforged anim Dyed.gif| Particles (Dyed) ==Trivia== *The Bloodforged Crown is one of very few equipment to provide an Attunement-based Talent ([[Flamecharm]] in this case) without any stat requirements. *This [[Equipment]] piece shares the same innate stats as [[Celtor Commander Helm]]. *Goes great with [[Curse of the No Life King]] builds, due to the fact that the innate Talent decreases blood loss, one of No Life King's greatest weaknesses. **Be aware that NLK has heavily reduced effectiveness from both {{t|Cauterized Wounds}} and {{t|Alloyblood}}. *Due to its rarity, age, and prevalence within the trading community, this item is seen as the baseline item for trading, where the value of other items is often measured in comparison to the Bloodforged Crown. However, the Bloodforged Crown's value has declined over time, as rarer and more sought after items have been added to the game. {{History}} {{Nav|Equipment}} [[Category:Equipment]] [[Category:Head]] [[Category:Ornaments]] [[Category:Equipment with Talents]] [[Category:Equipment with Non-exclusive Talents]]

Its jagged edge cleaves through foes with unsettling ease, drinking deep of their blood to empower its wielder's divine purpose. When your fingers graze its serrated edge, horrors unlike any you've known flicker through your mind, small glimpses of something vast and unknowable. ==Description==
The Bloodfouler is a [[Weapons|Legendary Greatsword]]; a massive odachi that is as fearsome as it is long, commissioned by an unknown member of the Ministry during their training to one day become a prophet. The blade is well decorated in a crimson pattern, as well as its sheathe proving its intricate craft even more. It consists of a now worn, serrated blade and a hilt wrapped in scarlet cloth. The odachi sports decorative symbols along its make, and spikes that crop out opposite to the edge early into the blade's spine. It also comes with a strapped and black leather sheathe. 

The Bloodfouler scales off [[Attributes|Heavy Weapons]] alongside [[Bloodrend]]. The weapon can be acquired by retrieving three [[Strange Tomes]] from the following:

#[[Volu]], who is leaned against the wall in [[Outpost Antumbra]]'s basement.
#As a drop from [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract]].
#As a drop from [[The Understrand]] after defeating the [[Ministry Agent]].

When all three have been retrieved, they can be placed on the case that is right next to Volu, thus putting the Bloodfouler into your hands.

It can also be obtained as a direct drop from [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract|Chaser]], as well as [[The Diluvian Mechanism]].

==Critical==
<gallery widths="300" position="center">
File:Bloodfouler crit.gif|Standing Critical
File:BloodfoulerCritical2.gif|Running Critical
</gallery>
For the '''standing''' critical, the user moves forward in the direction they are facing doing a 360° sweep, striking the opponent and applying Blood Poisoning and briefly ragdolling them. The standing critical has the following stats: 1.4x scaled damage multiplier, inflicts 10% Blood Poisoning, and has a 1 second windup.

For the '''running''' critical, the user rushes forward and performs a much quicker sweep before striking the opponent, applying Blood Poisoning. The running critical has the following stats: 1.15x scaled damage multiplier, inflicts 10% Blood Poisoning, has a 0.75 second windup, and deals 35+ posture.

The cooldown for both criticals is '''10 seconds'''.

==Gallery==
<gallery widths="250" position="center">
File:Blood m1.gif|M1 cycle
File:BloodfoulerInSheathe.png|Sheathed Bloodfouler
File:BloodfoulerBladeInLighting.png|Bloodfouler's blade
File:BloodfoulerSymbols1.png|Bloodfouler's symbols
</gallery>

==Trivia== 
*The sheathe depicts symbols of [[The Ministry]], alongside an emblem resembling the symbol for [[Notes]], the [[Moonseye]], and another pattern.
*The creator of the Bloodfouler is likely an Etrean due to the Ministry's ties with Etrea, as well as the weapon's shape being derived from Etrean make.
*It does not change appearance with Alloyblood.
*Despite coming with a sheathe, the [[Poser's Ring]] does not work with it and nor does the Paired Soul Talent from the [[Vigil Initiate]], [[Cloak of Winds]], and [[Royal Etrean Guard]] [[Outfits]].

{{ItemTemplate |image=Bloodless Gem.png |value=80 |weight=1 |stack=25 |type=Deep Gem |rarity=Legendary |desc=It bleeds... ---- On hit, heal for 30% of the unscaled damage dealt, but reduce the damage dealt to your opponent by 20%. After healing 15 HP, goes on cooldown for 2s. |obtainment= *[[Primadon]] *[[Maestro Evengarde Rest]] *[[Chaser]] *[[Scion of Ethiron]] *[[Ferryman]] *[[Lodestar|Lodestar Bounty]] job *[[First Layer]] *[[Sea Events]] *[[Fishing]] *[[Cinders of Etris]] *[[Deep Crucible]] *[[Widow's Wail Cemetery#Trial of the Gourdskipper|Trial of the Gourdskipper]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] *[[Saramaed Hollow]] {{iv|Vow of Iron}}: *[[Ether Erudite]] Memento *Found in {{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} *{{iv|The Depths (Vow of Iron)|The Depths}} chests}} ==Description== The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a dark red diamond-shaped [[Deep Gem]]. ==Effect== File:Bloodless.gif|alt= Upon landing a Mantra with a Bloodless Gem equipped, heal for 30% of the scaled damage dealt at the cost of your Mantra's scaled damage being reduced by 20%. This has a healing cap of 15 health. Reaching this cap will put Bloodless Gem on cooldown for 2 seconds. ===Notes=== *This Gem is best used on high damage Mantras, especially those that hit multiple times or can hit multiple opponents at once. *The formula for Bloodless Gem's healing is as follows:
ScaledDamage \times 0.8 \times 0.3 **Notably, the healing formula is based on your damage '''before''' Bloodless Gem's reduced damage effect is applied. **Although the description states "unscaled damage," it actually means damage before modifiers and resistances are applied, '''not''' base damage. *The heal cap of 15 will be reached once you deal 63 scaled damage. *While Bloodless Gems are on cooldown, your Mantra's damage will be restored to normal and the healing will be disabled. *If you have the {{cl|brain|Brain}} {{status|Food Buff}} from the [[Grilled Parasol Brain]], {{PAGENAME}}'s healing cap will be increased from 15 to 20. **You will need to deal at least 84 scaled damage to hit this heal cap. *[[The No-Life King's Crown]] increases the healing cap of Bloodless Gems to 30, at the cost of reducing the healing received from Bloodless Gems by 33%. **This changes the Bloodless Gem healing formula to:
ScaledDamage \times 0.8 \times 0.67 \times 0.3 **With this equipment, you will need to have a scaled damage of 94 or higher to heal more than 15 heath, and a scaled damage of 187 to reach the 30 heal cap. **When paired with the {{cl|brain|Brain}} Food Buff, you will need to have a scaled damage of 218 to heal 35 health from Bloodless Gems. *The Bloodless Gem effect can be enhanced with the [[:Category:Equipment with Set Bonuses|Bloodcurdle]] and [[:Category:Equipment with Set Bonuses|Regenerative Equipment Sets]], granting 50% of Bloodless Gem's healing [[Temporary Health]] when you proc the Gem. ==Crafting== This Gem can also be used as a crafting component for various items. *[[Outfits]]: [[Arachnid's Weave]], [[Celtorian Tideknight]], [[Familiar Occultist's Armor]], [[Prophet's Cloak]], [[Sanguine Finery]], [[Summer Dragoon]], and [[Titanslayer's Adornment]]. {{History}} [[Category:Treasures]] [[Category:Mantras]] [[Category:Deep Gems]]

title: Bloodrend
content:
{{Quotes|quote=Casting your mind back, you may recall a Black Diver of note was unveiled as the treacherous Crimson Scholar of Burning Blood, a student of the Second Prophet... But what of the Second Prophet's other students? Perhaps one of them might be more sympathetic; perhaps they might even be willing to share what they know of the mysteries of Blood? |author=Hallowtide 2024 Patch Notes}} [[File:Bloodrend.png|thumb|Bloodrend Icon]] == Description == '''Bloodrend''' is an [[Attunement]] that grants the user the ability to control, manipulate, and conjure their own and other's [https://deepwoken.fandom.com/wiki/Combat_Mechanics#Survival_Basics blood]. Bloodrenders excel in long fights, their power ramping up as the fight goes on due to the effects applied to enemies from Blood Poison and Blood Drain. They can counter their opponents' sustain while using sustain to benefit themselves. However, Bloodrend is difficult to make use of outside of single target combat, as blood poison decays, making it hard to achieve high percentages of it against multiple enemies. It's extremely effective at long to mid range. To counter this attunement, prioritize staying up close and applying constant pressure, as Bloodrend lacks close range low windup mantras. Keep in mind that any mistake is likely to lead to you getting severely punished by the Bloodrend user, even at close range from Mantras like [[Bloodcurdle]]. ==PvE Mechanic(s)== Bloodrenders can leverage the '''Hemorrhaging''' mechanic, dealing a percentage, scaling on Bloodrend investment and player level, of a PvE enemy's current health in a singular damage instance, once a threshold of blood loss is met. At Power 20 with 100 Bloodrend, this deals 17.5% of the target's current health. This threshold can be built up by using any source of blood loss, not exclusively Bloodrend, and does not explicitly require the player to be a Bloodrender to use. When this procs, the enemy will lose a percentage of the {{status|Blood Poisoning}} you've applied to them. ==Obtainment== The [[Attunement Trainers|Attunement Trainer]], [[Vyrelda]], can be located in an igloo on the east side of Firfire Village, caring for an injured diver. She is only visible after having killed [[Chaser, Scholar of the Crimson Contract|Chaser]] at least once. After killing Chaser, re-enter Layer 2 and go talk with Vyrelda - she will talk about her desertion from [[The Ministry]], and how she evaded the Ministry for so long, who are searching for her. She mentions "Bloodrend" and how she only wished to be taught under the Second Prophet for purely the attunement. After Vyrelda's backstory, the player will be prompted to request for Bloodrend. Vyrelda agrees to teach the latter under the condition that the player deals with some [[Ministry Bloodrender]]s to gain [[Heartstar]]s from their corpses. Walk out the building, and run around the village for a while. The blood-renders will notice you as a threat and begin to engage. Kill all the three cultists for 3 Heartstars, and return to Vyrelda to get the Curseblood potion. Upon usage, your body aches in pain for a split second. You have gained access to Bloodrend. *'''You don't have to re-kill Chaser to keep the Attunement, you can keep it by using a [[Light Hook]] to leave L2''' After having unlocked Bloodrend at least once, [[Vyrelda]] will be available at [[Derelict Highchurch|The Derelict Highchurch]], where she will request 2 [[Heartstar]]s for the [[Attunement]] (you can easily obtain them via the ministry agents that spawn right outside of the church after talking to her.) It will also be available from the [[Character Creation|character creation]] screen. She can train your mantras in exchange for Notes. ==Training== {{text|att-training |train=using the [[Tourniquet]] to increase the attribute after landing {{PAGENAME}} Mantras to gain enough EXP |trainer=[[Vyrelda]] at the [[Derelict Highchurch]] }} ===Mantra Damage Calculation=== {{text|mantracalc}} ==Cantrip(s)== Cantrips are, often minor, passive abilities that are granted upon obtaining any Mantra from the respective Attunement. ===Bloodless=== This Cantrip visually hides the blood splotches that appear on the player's [[Outfit]] when at low health. This is purely visual. The {{t|Not a Scratch}} Talent also provides this effect, among other things. ===Carnivorous=== This Cantrip allows the player to consume raw meat-type [[Food]] items without vomiting. Even still, eating raw meat isn't very recommended, as the cooked versions provide significantly more sustenance and may grant additional buffs on consumption. [[Vegetarian]] Bloodrenders may still vomit upon comsuming meat-type Food items. ==Mantras == All Bloodrend Mantras have 2.75 Bloodrend scaling unless stated otherwise. ===Combat Mantras=== {{MantraInfobox|newtable |name=Blood Orb (☆☆☆) |image=Bloodorb gif.gif |desc=Release an amalgamation of your blood. |ethercost={{stats|ether|60 Ether}} |dmgtype={{stats|bld|Blood}} |reqs=1 Bloodrend |effect=''Launch an orb-shaped projectile of blood to wherever the character is facing.'' *Deals 14.5/19/23.5/28/32.5 base damage per level, 8 posture, 0.6 windup, Has 10s CD *Multi spark version deals 6.83/8.33/9.83/11.33/12.83 base damage per level, per orb, 2 posture per orb, 0.6s windup 10s CD *Has 9.31x PVE scaling *Each orb leaves behind a blood pool. *Can be modified with a Multiplying Spark, making it launch 3 orbs instead. **Damage per orb gets reduced, however, hitting all 3 orbs ends up dealing more damage than the non-spark version. (40 Bloodrend) |Guardbreaking enemies leaves enemies more susceptible to blood loss from Bloodrend mantras. | |- |} ==Trivia== *'''WARNING''' ONCE 6 BLOOD POOLS ARE PLACED THEY WILL QUICKLY DISSAPATE *Blood Poison is a stacking effect that is applied on the blood bar. '''It does not replace blood''', simply overlay itself on top of it. *Blood Poison can proc effects to an enemy upon reaching a certain percentage, here they are: **20% - {{cl|raretlnf|Vasculitis}} is activatable ***{{cl|raretl|Vasculitis}} - Hitting your opponent while they have over 20% blood poisoning disables their deep gems for a brief duration while giving you [[Status Effects#Gem Enhancement|Gem Enhancement]] against PvE temporarily. **25% - {{cl|raretlnf|Hemolysis}} Talent is Activatable ***{{cl|raretl|Hemolysis}} - Deal 20% more critical attack damage. **40% - Enemies are under an Anti-Heal effect **50% - Enemies have their damage reduced **60% - {{cl|raretlnf|Bloodwarden's Sense}} Talent is Activatable ***{{cl|raretl|Bloodwarden's Sense}} - Enemies you attack with a mantra are highlighted red briefly. **70% - {{cl|advancedtlnf|''Gruesome Harvest''}} Talent is Activatable ***{{cl|advancedtl|Gruesome Harvest}} - Landing Bloodrend mantras on opponents will give you 15 temporary health. *The [[Ironsing]] Talent, {{cl|advancedtlnf|Alloyblood}} changes the color of your Bloodrend mantras to a grey-ish blue. Alloyblood Wisp.png *Chaser seems to be using his own version of Bloodrend - tailored and handcrafted by none other than the Second Prophet, as said in [[Vyrelda]]'s dialogue, which is special. *While Bloodrend might seem like it'd be a good counter against [[Curse of the No Life King]] users and people with the [[Haemophilia]] Flaw, Bloodrend Mantra blood drain is actually entirely unaffected by blood damage modifiers. *The blood cost for casting Bloodrend Mantras is also completely unaffected by blood damage modifiers like {{t|Alloyblood}}, {{t|Cauterized Wounds}}, [[Curse of the No Life King]] Enchant, and the aforementioned [[Haemophilia]] Flaw; removing the possible synergy between Bloodrend and [[Bloodforged Crown]]. *Attempting to complete [[Vyrelda]]'s quest with multiple people will only spawn three enemies. These enemies will respawn upon talking to her again on another run. Along with this, [[Heartstar]]s are not affected by Light Hook, allowing you to save them for other Layer 2 runs if you end up with only 1 or 2 instead of 3. *{{cl|bld|'''Sanguine Dive'''}} is a reference to Vladimir's W ability in ''League of Legends''. *{{cl|bld|'''Bloodtide Ritual'''}} is a reference to [https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Mohg,_Lord_of_Blood Mohg, Lord of Blood's] phase transition move "Bloodboon Ritual" from ''Elden Ring''. *{{cl|bld|'''Bloodedge'''}} is likely a reference to Naoto Kurogane's "Bloodedge" and "Edge of Eternity" from BlazBlue Centralfiction. *{{cl|bld|'''Bloodcurdle'''}} is likely a reference to bloodbending from Avatar: The Last Airbender *{{cl|bld|'''Veinbreaker'''}} is likely a reference to Slayer's "Mappa hunch" in Guilty Gear Strive. *{{cl|bld|'''Crucifixion'''}} is a reference to Klaus' "Unbreakable Cross Shield" from ''Blood Blockade Battlefront''; confirmed by a tester. *{{cl|bld|'''Vein Tendrils'''}} could be a reference to Spider-Man, from Marvel Comics. *'''{{cl|bld|'''Scarlet Cyclone'''}}''' was changed from 0 stars to 2 stars in the {{VersionHistory|2026|February, 26th}} update. {{Nav|Attunements}} [[Category:Attunement]]

That place can't hold me...|author=The Bloodstarved Hunter upon being executed.}}{{EnemyInfobox |health=? |drops=[[The Death Knell]] |weapon=[[The Death Knell]] |moves=*Revenge *Judgement |image1=Cerebral Hunter Front.png |caption1=The Metamancer aficionado |affiliation=[[The Ministry]]}} ==Description== The Bloodstarved Hunter is a Mini Boss exclusive to [[Vow of Iron]]. They have a chance to appear when igniting a [[Sanguine Candle]]. The Bloodstarved Hunter is a [[Ganymede]], wearing a [[Big Herbalist's Hat]], [[Hivelord Mask]] (dyed black), and the sleeves of a [[Diver's Light Plate]]. ==Moveset== The Bloodstarved Hunter wields [[The Death Knell]] and utilizes strings similar to contractors. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description |Media |- |
'''Assault'''
(★☆☆) |Performs 3 basic attacks before sending the opponent away with a flourish. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:LFT M1 Cycle.gif|thumb]] |- |
'''Critical'''
(★★☆) |Jim uses the Death Knell critical (identical to [[Light's Final Toll]]). {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Navae_LFT_Crit.gif|thumb]] |- |

==Description==
{{PAGENAME}} is a damage dealing [[enchantment]] that explodes your opponent after enough time has passed.

==Effect==
After landing enough weapon hits, {{PAGENAME}} applies a 10 second countdown on your opponent. Landing weapon attacks will shorten the duration of the countdown by 1 second. Once the countdown ends, your opponent will explode after a 1 second delay, dealing damage scaling on your Weapon investment.

This attack has a base damage of 27.5, and is dealt as typeless damage. Bluster's damage is increased by 0.25 for every point in Weapon investment you have, up to 52.5 damage at 100 weapon.

The hit count required to proc this enchantment varies based on your weapon type, requiring 5 hits for [[Light Weapons]], 4 hits for [[Medium Weapons]], and 3 hits for [[Heavy Weapons]].

===Notes===
*Bluster can be blocked and parried, dealing 10 posture damage if blocked.
*Bluster procs certain "on flourish" Talents such as [[Chainlash]] and [[Hidden Tendril]].

title: Boatman's Watch
content:
{{Location|name=Boatman's Watch|area=Voidzone|caption=A place remembered only by the waves.}}
[[File:BoatmansWatch.jpg|thumb|900px|center]]

==Overview==
Boatman's Watch is a small island located in the [[Voidsea]]. The island is covered in vegetation and an arena can be found in the center.  

*Boatman's Watch can be found in the Eastern Luminant, by sailing through the gate to the right of [[Miner's Landing]], then taking a left off the highway and sailing past the left side of a giant rock you'll see in the ocean. If you see multiple whirlpools or floating trees, you're in the right direction.

==Potential Enemies==
{{EnemyGallery
|Theferryman.png|The Ferryman
}}

== Missions ==
[[The Ferryman]] can be fought here. For more information on his attacks, see [[The Ferryman|here]]. 

[[Oath: Saltchemist|Saltchemist]] can also be obtained here, by talking to [[Adrofalis]] after completing [[Ciea]]'s quest. For more information on the obtainment and requirements, read [[Oath: Saltchemist]].

===<u>Ferryman</u>=== 
#Enter the arena in the middle of the island.
# Build a [[Campfire|Campfire Pit]] on each end of the circle in the middle.
# Ignite all four [[Campfire|Campfire Pits]].
#A Teleportation ring will spawn, and standing in it will teleport you to an instanced server with purple flames on the [[Campfire|campfires]]
#Interact with him and the battle will start.

*Rewards in high-tier EXP and a seasonal reward.

Once spawned, you will not be able to leave Boatman's Watch until you defeat [[The Ferryman|The]] [[The Ferryman|Ferryman]] and leave through the portal, die or combat log.

==Trivia==
[[File:The Mines.png|right|frameless|260x260px]]
[[File:Library.PNG|alt=Library located past a breakable wall|right|frameless|263x263px]] 

*The music for this area is [[To Shores, Distant]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
*Close to the shore, some [[Fishing|fishing spots]] can be found.
*Since there are trees around the island, you can chop them down and craft [[Campfire|campfires]] in case you don't have any.
*The combat music for this area is [[To Fight, Sanguine]] by [[User:Naktigonis|Naktigonis]].
* Boatman's Watch can be found by going straight along the wall opposite (towards hive) from the [[Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse|Eastern]] [[Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse|Interstitial]] [[Eastern Interstitial Lighthouse|Lighthouse]] into the [[Voidsea]], visible after about 20 seconds of sailing.
*A hidden mine and library can be found in Boatman's Watch through destructible walls.
*Although not really trivial, there are two [[Egg|eggs]] in this island, one found on a tree growing on the rocks near the dock and another found in a bigger tree growing in a patch of grass to the right of [[The Ferryman|Ferryman]]'s location, these two [[Egg|eggs]] can be used to create [[Mushroom Omelette]]s with the high abundancy of [[Gobletto|Goblettos]] which can be helpful in the fight against [[The Ferryman]].
*Within the Ferryman's instance, the tree behind the teleporter will have [[sap]] that does not deplete after 5-20 collections. This can be a very consistent way of getting [[sap]], if you ever need it.
*Despite the fact that [[Adrofalis]] has not entered [[The Ferryman]]'s portal, he can still  hear their music and lightning.

==Description==

The '''Boltcrusher''' is a Legendary [[Weapons|Greathammer]]: a powerful engine cased with various parts and plates atop a wieldy metal spine. On the back of the hammer's head is a driven drill, and on its front is a weighted blunt piece to offset the weight of the drill and deal damage. It scales with [[Thundercall]] alongside [[Attributes|Heavy Weapons]].

Drilling-edge [[Ignition Union]] technology, the Boltcrusher was devised by [[Ignition Deepdelver]]s in order to assist in [[Depths]] resource extraction.

The Boltcrusher is obtained as a guaranteed drop from [[Finnegan The Lost]], an enemy NPC found in the [[First Layer]] of [[The Depths]] as part of the "[[Finnegan The Lost|Drowned Delver]]" Job. The Job itself can be taken from [[Job Boards]] scattered in a variety of locations, with an increased spawnrate at [[the Chariot's Spire]].

The Boltcrusher comes with two passive abilities:

*'''Powered By A Spark''' - Every basic attack will apply [[Shock]]ed or Surge stacks.
*'''Mining Sufficient''' - The Boltcrusher is capable of mining [[Ores]], and with greater efficiency.

==Critical==
<gallery widths="215" position="center">
File:Regular Boltcrusher Critical (Standing).gif|Standing Critical
File:Regular Boltcrusher Critical (Running).gif|Running Critical

</gallery>

The Boltcrusher has two criticals.

For the standing critical, the user reels back the weapon, drilling into them before spinning around and clobbering the enemy with the hammerhead side of the weapon, applying Sapped to the target. This has an estimated 1.6x multiplier. {{Text|slowturn}}

For the running critical, The user lifts the Boltcrusher up above their head before slamming it into the ground using the hammerhead side, creating a shockwave of lightning, applying Sapped to the target. This has an estimated 1.4x multiplier.

Both the running and the standing version share a cooldown of '''10 seconds'''.

title: Bone Keeper
content:
{{Quotes|quote=It's not somewhere one would want to stay for long. In my few ventures in there, I've always heard loud stomping... behind me, almost? I didn't want to stay to find out what was making those noises.|author=Sarkale talking about the Firfire Caverns}} {{Monster Infobox |health=9500 23750 {{cl|corrupted|(Corrupted)}} |drops=*[[Giant Femur]] |attacks= *Spin Thrust *Leap *Crushing Grab *Charge *Bone Spikes *Femur Throw |image1=Bonekeeper.png |locations=*[[The Ethironal Shrine]] *[[Cathedral of the Interstice]] *[[The Diluvian Mechanism]] }} ==Description== The Bone Keeper is a Monster mainly found in the [[Second Layer|Eternal Gale]]. It can also appear in the [[Pathfinder]] Depths Trial when you have 20 Drowns, potentially {{cl|corrupted|Corrupted}}, and in the {{iv|Vow of Iron}} Depths Trial when Power 5 and below. Bone Keepers in the {{iv|Vow of Iron}} have vastly less cooldown between their moves and their moves also play out faster, but they have far less health than they do in [[Pathfinder]]. Bone Keepers are giant, humanoid creatures, with inhuman proportions, having short legs yet large arms. It has noticeably clawed feet, with bone claws for hands. They sport a red and gold loincloth of sorts on their lower body and lack clothing on their upper half. Their head also appears to be made out of a cylindrical formation of bones. It is a highly persistent, mobile and hard-hitting Monster, featuring high health and high punishing damage for those unprepared. They are certainly a large difficulty step-up from the Monsters found in the [[First Layer]]. However, all of their attacks are well-telegraphed and can be consistently avoided with proper experience. Even then, be wary of not messing up, especially if the Bone Keeper is Corrupted. ==Attacks== If you would prefer a visual guide, consider watching ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMXwczlX4YE this video]''. {| class="fandom-table" !Name/Danger !Description !Media |- |
'''Crushing Grab'''
(★★★) |The {{PAGENAME}} holds its right arm high up before swinging forwards with it, and if it manages to grab a target, it will hold it up before crushing it in its hand, dealing devastating damage. *This attack seems to lack much range, meaning it can be avoided by simply stepping back before it tries to grab you. {{AttackTags |indicator = dodge |parry.n, block.y, dodge.y, grab, autogrip |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Crushing Grab.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Charge'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} readies up a stance before charging forward, ragdolling and knocking those hit, as well as dealing considerable health damage and posture damage. The {{PAGENAME}} skids to a stop if successfully parried. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, movement, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Charge.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Spin Thrust'''
(★☆☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} will wind up its right arm, before thrusting forward with its hand spinning, hitting three times. *It may follow up with '''Leap''', even if you parried, with it being more likely if you didn't. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y }} |[[File:Triple Slash.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Leap'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} leaps a small distance towards its target, crushing it with its impact, dealing serious damage if not avoided. *It seems to lack range, especially since it leaps towards you, potentially overshooting, meaning it can be avoided as long as you dont move towards where it is going to land. *It can be countered by rolling under it while its in the air {{AttackTags |indicator = avoid |parry.n, block.y, dodge.n, autogrip |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Triple Slash Leap.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Bone Spikes'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} raises its leg and stomps the ground, emitting a long carpet of rising bones in front of it. *You can jump to avoid the rising bones, but your timing will depend on the distance from you to the {{PAGENAME}}. {{AttackTags |indicator = jump |parry.n, block.y, dodge.n, ragdoll, jump |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Bone Spikes.gif|border|frameless]] |- |
'''Femur Throw'''
(★★☆) |The {{PAGENAME}} digs into the ground with its right arm before pulling out a large femur bone, holding it with winding motions before throwing it towards its target at absurd speeds. *The femur itself behaves like a projectile, with a small AoE on impact and being able to collide with the physical world. *The timing for your defense depends on your distance from the {{PAGENAME}}. {{AttackTags |parry.y, block.y, dodge.y, ragdoll |type2_color = DarkOrange }} |[[File:Ezgif-2-a87d608fac.gif|border|frameless]] |} ===Passives=== * '''Monster Resistance''' - Physical attacks deal 20% less damage to the Bone Keeper. ==Gallery== File:Layer 2 Concept Art.png|Concept art File:Bonekeeper Honest Reaction.png|Close-up File:The Freddy Kruger.png|Full-body File:Bonekeeper sukuna pose jjk ep1.png File:Bonekeeper Grabs You yes YOU.png File:Hell yeah! Hell yeah! Hell yeah! hell yes! Fuck no! Hell no! Hello! Hi!.png File:Bonekeeper Dab Me Up!!!.png File:Bonekeeper offers you an ice cream.png File:Bonekeeper Jump Attack.png File:Bonekeeper Tom Holland Jump Bro Thinks He's Him.png File:Bonekeeper -e bowdown.png File:Bonekeeper Giant Femur Throw.png File:Bonekeeper left foot left stomp.png File:Bonekeeper Spike Wall of DOOM(house).png File:Bonekeeper Dancing to "elle spongebob car".png File:Bonekeeper Death.png|A dead Bone Keeper File:BonekeeperFly.gif|Comical death ragdoll ==Trivia== *Bone Keepers used to heal at a rate of 20 health per second (60 when Corrupted). This made them extremely tedious to defeat at times, locking out lower DPS builds from fighting them. After being made to fight it with [[Jus Karita]] and no equipment, which resulted in 70+ deaths, ''Deepwoken'' developer Ragoozer had it removed.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rVWCMiHQY4w **This same update also buffed Jus Karita. *Bone Keepers are the precursors of the [[Kyrsgarde]], as mentioned by the [[Kyrsglaive]] description. *The one found on the bridge before the Generator in [[Second Layer/The Ethironal Shrine|The Eternal Gale]] does not have knockback on its '''Charge''' and '''Femur Throw''' moves. content:
{{PathfinderEx}}

==Description==
Bookkeeper Andros is an [[:Category:NPCs|NPC]]. He offers information related to The Old World. He is crucial towards the obtainment for [[Oath: Soulbreaker|Soulbreaker]] telling you about the King's Ardour and his abilities providing a lot of information about him, and provides information about [[The Lord Regent]] in the quest to defeat [[Duke Erisia]].

==Location==
Bookkeeper Andros is located in [[Etris]] in his small library that is nearby the inn, he stands near the chimney.
<gallery widths="300px">
Bookkeeper Andros's Library.png{{!}}His Library
Bookkeeper Andros's Location.png{{!}}Bookkeeper Andros's Location
</gallery>

==Dialogue==
<tabber>
|-|First Encounter=
{{#tag:tabber|Base Dialogue=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Oh! Uh, hello. Pardon me, I was rather deep in thought.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}About what?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Well, I was reading through a book my grandfather left me... one of the {{g|The Old World|old world}}, yes?... It spoke of the trade routes frequented in those days, but peculiarly these journeys were taken by horse and carriage, rather than by sea.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}[Continue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Isn't that remarkable? That they travelled such distances by animal? Just what world did our ancestors live in?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Enemy Reputation=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Huh? I'm sorry... I don't have anything for you. Please, I could get into a lot of trouble for speaking to you.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}
}}

|-|Subsequent Encounters=
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}These old books are more of a passing fancy of mine, but I've heard there's an order of scholars that devote their life to researching the {{g|The Old World|old world}}. Don't you wonder what things were like back then?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Is there anything you can tell me about Etris?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Is there anything you can tell me about the Old World?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}If you head past the inn, you'll find the Lord Regent's estate. I would not advise entering without an invitation, however. Even a bookish fool such as I knows when I am not welcome.
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}There is much for us all to learn about it and its people. I'm by no means an expert, but my grandfather was one of the {{g|The Old Stewards|Old Stewards}}, the keepers of the knowledge of the {{g|The Old World|Old World}}. Perhaps if you were able to find one of these {{g|The Old Stewards|Old Stewards}} they might be able to answer any burning questions of yours.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who is this Lord Regent exactly?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The Lord Regent is the 'acting regent' of Etrea. That is to say, he is not the prophesied King, but he still holds absolute power over Etrea. In recent years, he has sequestered himself away in his palace, rarely making an appearance. Some worry that he has grown ill, but considering that his duties have not been passed on to any of his officials, I doubt this is the case.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

|-|Unlockable Dialogues=
{{#tag:tabber|Old King of Etrea=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has spoken to [[Theadre]] and asked "What do you think of The Lord Regent?"
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}These old books are more of a passing fancy of mine, but I've heard there's an order of scholars that devote their life to researching the {{g|The Old World|old world}}. Don't you wonder what things were like back then?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}I've heard about a King of Etrea, what can you tell me about him?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Ah, hard to avoid hearing about him here. He's somewhat of a mythical figure, though there was a real man behind all the myth. King Rolen Vashtir I reigned through the early 6th century CE and made quite a name for himself and Etrea on the world stage. As fate would sadly have it, he set off on a voyage with a small fleet of ships and never returned
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}The 6th century CE?! They don't seriously think he's coming back, do they?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Even if it's farfetched, I suppose waiting for his return gives people something to hope for.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Well, you know how myths and legends are. You could call it wishful thinking, but with the strange state of our world, crazier things have happened, no?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Quite so. The Kingdom has never quite bounced back from the loss of their king. Though he was by no means a perfect man in life, he has grown into something larger than just a man in myth?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So there haven't been any kings since?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="2" {{!}}Indeed. Since the King's departure, the Kingdom has been governed by a line of Lord Guardians - stewards of the throne who are er... ''warming the seat'', so to speak. Of course, the Lord Regent does not style himself as such... Ahem. Was there anything else you wanted to know?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who is this Lord Regent exactly?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Is what they say of the King's Ardour true? Or is that just a myth, too?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}[See previous instance]
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}''*The Bookkeeper flashes a brief smile at you before tidying away some notes.*'' Oh, it's quite true. And not just Ardour, either. Many sources suggest he was capable of wielding all three.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}All three? How's that?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The myths differ in their accounts, but they speak of him travelling to the {{g|The Southern Luminant|Southern Luminant}} to strike a deal with an entity of some kind. Some attribute it to {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}}, others to something more ancient. Perhaps even something from ''below''...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}A deal?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}Mm. Much like the Splinterblade that the King is famed for, the legends say that the deal he struck split his soul into three parts in order to accomplish the feat.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Mur of Light=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has spoken to [[Theadre]] and asked "This King - is he some kind of god?"
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}These old books are more of a passing fancy of mine, but I've heard there's an order of scholars that devote their life to researching the {{g|The Old World|old world}}. Don't you wonder what things were like back then?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's the deal with this 'Mur' figure?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}Well, you'll get a lot of conflicting answers depending on who you ask. Here in Etrea, she's fabled as the Goddess who blessed the Etreans of the {{g|The Resurgence|Resurgence}} with the understanding of {{g|Soul Murmur|Murmurs}}, The more ''contemporary'' views here is that she was a {{g|The Celestials|Celestial}} who aided Etrea. Though, uh. Be careful who you bring that up around. There are many in these parts who adhere to the old faith rather zealously...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}And what do you think?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="6" {{!}}''*He nervously scratches behind his ear.*'' What I can say is... Ah... Well. I can't say that I have ''personally'' seen a great deal of information about {{g|Mur of Light|Mur}} ''outside'' of Etrea.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So...
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Speaking rather tactically here, aren't we?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}Well, it's possible that she only made herself known to those of the {{g|The Etrean Luminant|Etrean Luminant}}. And it's also possible that if she appeared in other lands, they may well have given her another name... ''*He sighs.*'' When it comes to {{g|The Celestials|Celestials}}, there's really no way of knowing unless you find the damned things and talk to them.
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*He gives you a wry smile.*'' The tolerance of historians and recordkeepers only extend so far as you don't start contradicting what people already hold to be true. Books are... flammable things. Accidents happen. Often to historians with mysteriously large paper cuts in their abdomen.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Have you spoken to a Celestial?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}So...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}''*His attention affixes itself to the grain of the wood behind you.*'' No. Don't be foolish, I'm not so fortunate as that. Anyway. Was there anything else you'd like to know about?
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Is there anything you can tell me about Etris?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Is there anything you can tell me about the Old World?
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}What's the deal with this 'Mur' figure?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{!}}[See first instance]
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="3" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}

{{!}}-{{!}}Lord Regent=
This dialogue is unlocked if the player has started the "Lord Regent Who?" [[Quest]].
{{{!}} class="mw-collapsible fandom-table article-table" style="width: 100%; text-align:center;"
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|begin}} {{!}}Begin Dialogue
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}These old books are more of a passing fancy of mine, but I've heard there's an order of scholars that devote their life to researching the {{g|The Old World|old world}}. Don't you wonder what things were like back then?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Is there anything you can tell me about Etris?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}If you head past the inn, you'll find the Lord Regent's estate. I would not advise entering without an invitation, however. Even a bookish fool such as I knows when I am not welcome.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Who is this Lord Regent exactly?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}The Lord Regent is the 'acting regent' of Etrea. That is to say, he is not the prophesied King, but he still holds absolute power over Etrea. In recent years, he has sequestered himself away in his palace, rarely making an appearance. Some worry that he has grown ill, but considering that his duties have not been passed on to any of his officials, I doubt this is the case.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Do you know anything about his rise to power? A guard I met is curious about what has become of Etrean politics.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}What's perhaps more interesting is that we ''don't'' know all too much about his rise to power. Before his rise to power, there was an officially recognised historian in the Etrean court. I had once hoped that I myself could fill such a position, but it no longer exists. It's said that when the Lord Regent came to power, half of the books in the libraries disappeared overnight.
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|reply}} {{!}}Do you know what happened to those records?
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{!}}It didn't seem wise to make a fuss over them. They were simply articles of public knowledge at the time, so I doubt they were stolen or anything like that. Whatever became of them is clearly nothing of anyone's business, so I'd recommend you don't dig further...
{{!}}-
{{!}} colspan="1" {{cl|end}} {{!}}[End Dialogue]
{{!}}}
}}
</tabber>

==Trivia==
*Bookkeeper Andros is the only NPC with the 'Generic' aspect, which is used ingame when your aspect does not load properly, as of the 8th of June 2025 you can see 'Generic' in the actual game via having a Kiron in the title screen.
*Bookkeeper Andros was one of the first NPCs added to Deepwoken closed community testing.
